title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
title_zh: Mingbird：一个本地优先的智能体运行框架，使小型开源模型能够完成真实任务

paragraphs.en: Small open-weight models (2–9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses × \times 4 open models (2B–35B) × \times 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired + 0.10 +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 小型开放权重模型（2–9B）可在普通笔记本电脑上运行，但在云级智能体框架中，它们很少能完成真实任务：工具预填充会超出上下文限制，自我修正会偏离方向，工具演示会陷入循环，任务也会悄无声息地被放弃。 我们通过受控的单机对比和一项第三方基准测试提供了证据，表明这些失败中的很大一部分应归因于框架本身，而非模型。 我们推出了 Mingbird——一款面向 Windows 和 Ollama 的本地优先智能体框架，其十种机制针对小型模型的各类失败形式进行了逐点对策；其中三种具有代表性：字节级净零预填充预算、在接受完成结果前重新读取任务的“完成门”，以及签名级循环检测。 在 LRAB 上，通过受控对比保持机器、模型、预算和评分一致（4 个框架 × \times 4 个开放模型（2B–35B）× \times 18 个真实任务，采用确定性产物评分），Mingbird 的整体得分为 0.886，而 goose 为 0.631、opencode 为 0.479、agent-mini 为 0.405；所有 288 个单元格均已公布。在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench（278 个任务，三组对比，统一协议）上，其总得分为 0.856，而另外两组分别为 0.791 和 0.737。在同一 18 个任务上对前沿模型进行的测试显示，不同框架间的得分跨度为 0.997 至 0.478，但结构良好的框架间差异始终控制在 0.072 以内。 我们报告了“移除单一机制”的消融分析结果，该结果仅具有方向性意义：对同一组对比在当晚进行的重复实验，其均值最多变化 0.069，这与单次试验的名义差异量相当；而唯一经过批次匹配的比较（完整机制堆栈与仅重新读取文本）显示，可执行完成守卫机制在三组重复实验中获得了成对的 +0.10 提升。 这些证据存在明确的局限性：基准测试为自构建、实验仅使用单台机器，且评分基于单次试验。

paragraphs.en: Open-weight language models in the 2–9B parameter range have crossed a practical threshold. On a laptop with an integrated GPU and 16–32 GB of shared memory they answer, summarize, translate, and explain at a level that makes them useful daily tools [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Local runtimes such as Ollama and llama.cpp made deployment a one-command operation [ 5 , 6 ] . The prevailing assumption is that such models cannot serve as agents — systems that autonomously execute multi-step, tool-mediated tasks: writing code that passes its tests, organizing files, conducting research with real search, or driving a domain database [ 7 , 8 ] . A recent position paper argues the opposite for agentic workloads [ 9 ] ; our results support that view, with one qualification: the limiting component is usually the harness rather than the model.
paragraphs.zh: 参数规模在 2–9B 范围内的开放权重语言模型已经跨越了一个实用性的阈值。 在配备集成 GPU 和 16–32 GB 共享内存的笔记本电脑上，它们能够以足以成为日常实用工具的水平进行回答、总结、翻译和解释 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 Ollama 和 llama.cpp 等本地运行时使部署只需执行一条命令即可完成 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 普遍的观点是，这类模型无法充当智能体——即能够自主执行多步骤、借助工具完成任务的系统：编写能通过测试的代码、整理文件、使用真实搜索功能开展研究，或操作领域数据库 [ 7 , 8 ] 。 最近一篇立场论文对智能体工作负载提出了相反观点 [ 9 ] ；我们的研究结果支持这一看法，但有一个前提：限制因素通常是运行环境而非模型本身。

sents.zh: 参数规模在 2–9B 范围内的开放权重语言模型已经跨越了一个实用性的阈值。

sents.en: A recent position paper argues the opposite for agentic workloads [ 9 ] ; our results support that view, with one qualification: the limiting component is usually the harness rather than the model.
sents.zh: 最近一篇立场论文对智能体工作负载提出了相反观点 [ 9 ] ；我们的研究结果支持这一看法，但有一个前提：限制因素通常是运行环境而非模型本身。

paragraphs.en: Our observations conflict with this assumption in a specific way: small models generally produce the correct next action, but cannot reliably emit and execute every step unaided, inside a harness designed for a much larger model. When we drove a 2B model with a cloud-scale agent framework, we observed the same failure forms repeatedly: the static tool prefill alone consumed a large fraction of the context (long-context degradation is well documented [ 8 ] ); the model could not self-correct after a failed tool call [ 10 , 11 ] ; it looped indefinitely on tool demonstrations; and it sometimes declared a task finished when the artifacts did not exist, or gave up halfway without saying so. These are not failures of capability. They are failures of the scaffold surrounding the model, and we treat them as engineering defects with corresponding engineering remedies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的观察结果以一种特定方式与这一假设相冲突：小型模型通常能生成正确的下一步动作，但无法在没有辅助的情况下，在专为大型模型设计的框架内可靠地执行每一步操作。 当我们使用云级智能体框架驱动一个 2B 模型时，我们反复观察到相同类型的故障：仅静态工具预填充就消耗了大部分上下文（长上下文退化已有充分记录 [8]）；模型在工具调用失败后无法自我纠正 [10, 11]；它会无限循环执行工具演示；有时它会在产物不存在时宣布任务完成，或者中途放弃却未作说明。 这些并非能力上的缺陷。 它们是围绕模型的框架所导致的故障，我们将其视为工程缺陷，并采用相应的工程方法予以解决。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes that argument concrete. We describe Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama, designed from the start for 2–9B models (upper bound tested at the 35B tier; Table 4 ). Mingbird is a GUI application and a CLI over one agent loop; it adds no inference machinery of its own and talks to whatever model Ollama serves. Its design consists of ten core mechanisms (M1–M10) plus a five-ring safety model (M14, v1.6.0; M11–M13 are product-level facilities, Section 3.2 ), each mapped to a failure form we first observed and then measured.
paragraphs.zh: 本文使这一论点具体化。 我们介绍了 Mingbird，这是一款面向 Windows 和 Ollama 的本地优先智能体工具，从一开始就为 2–9B 模型而设计（上限在 35B 层级进行了测试；见表 4）。 Mingbird 是一款图形用户界面应用程序，也是基于单一智能体循环的命令行工具；它本身不添加任何推理机制，而是与 Ollama 提供的任意模型进行交互。 其设计由十个核心机制（M1–M10）和一个五环安全模型（M14，v1.6.0；M11–M13 是产品级功能，见第 3.2 节）组成，每个机制都对应一种我们首先观察到、随后进行测量的故障形式。

sents.en: This paper makes that argument concrete.
sents.zh: 本文使这一论点具体化。

paragraphs.en: Measuring harness effects requires holding everything else constant, so we built LRAB (Local Real-task Agent Benchmark) as a controlled experiment: 4 harnesses (Mingbird, goose [ 12 ] , agent-mini [ 13 ] , and opencode [ 14 ] , all stock and unpatched) × \times 4 open models (2B, 4B, 12B, 35B; Table 4 ) × \times 18 real tasks, 288 cells in total, on one machine, one backend, uniform time budgets, and deterministic artifact-based scoring. Every one of the 288 cells is published as raw data; every aggregate from the unified-protocol campaigns is directly recomputable from the rows of a published CSV file (the legacy thinking-on sensitivity numbers, retained for comparison in Section 5.4 , are aggregate-level only). Because LRAB was designed by us, we also validate externally: on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench [ 15 ] , an independent benchmark we did not design, we ran all three domains (retail, airline, telecom) under one uniform protocol (Section 5.4 ). Over the 278 scored tasks (114 retail, 50 airline, 114 telecom), Mingbird totals 0.856 against 0.791 for the benchmark’s native agent and 0.737 for opencode; the goose arm is deferred for throughput (Section 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 要衡量 harness 的效果，必须保持其他所有因素不变，因此我们构建了 LRAB（本地真实任务智能体基准测试）作为一项受控实验：4 种 harness（Mingbird、goose [ 12 ]、agent-mini [ 13 ] 和 opencode [ 14 ]，均为原始未打补丁版本）× \times 4 种开放模型（2B、4B、12B、35B；见表格 4）× \times 18 项真实任务，总计 288 个单元格，全部在一台机器、一个后端上运行，采用统一的时间预算和基于确定性产出的评分机制。 这 288 个单元格中的每一个都以原始数据形式发布；所有来自统一协议实验的汇总结果都可以直接从已发布的 CSV 文件各行中重新计算得出（用于比较的旧版“思考敏感性”数值仅保留在汇总层面，见第 5.4 节）。 由于 LRAB 由我们自行设计，因此我们也进行了外部验证：在 τ 2 \tau^{2}-bench [ 15 ]（一项我们未参与设计的独立基准测试）上，我们在统一协议下运行了所有三个领域（零售、航空和电信）的测试（见第 5.4 节）。 在 278 项评分任务中（114 项零售、50 项航空、114 项电信），Mingbird 的总分为 0.856，而该基准测试的原生智能体得分为 0.791，opencode 得分为 0.737；goose 分支因吞吐量问题暂不纳入比较（见第 5.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: A mechanism set for small-model harnesses. Ten core design patterns plus a five-ring safety model (Section 3 ), each documented in the form failure form → \rightarrow mechanism → \rightarrow design trade-off , implemented in an open-source, Apache-2.0 harness and covered by 441 tests at the documented v1.6.0 release (461 at the v1.8.2 tag current at writing, Section B ) and a byte-level prefill regression gate; the safety model is additionally evaluated against a 54-case adversarial probe set on both small-tier models, one run per case (Section 3.2.11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为小型模型工具包设置的机制。 十种核心设计模式以及一个五环安全模型（第 3 节），每种都以“故障形式 → 机制 → 设计权衡”的形式记录，并实现于一个开源的 Apache-2.0 工具包中，在已记录的 v1.6.0 版本中通过 441 项测试（撰写时 v1.8.2 标签下为 461 项，见第 B 节），并包含字节级预填充回归检查；此外，该安全模型还针对小型模型上的 54 个对抗性探针用例进行了评估，每个用例运行一次（第 3.2.11 节）。

sents.en: A mechanism set for small-model harnesses.

paragraphs.en: A controlled comparison methodology. LRAB (Section 4 ) holds model, machine, backend, budgets, and scoring constant and varies only the harness; we frame the benchmark explicitly as a controlled experiment rather than a leaderboard, with the task set, the scoring code, and the complete data release published alongside it.
paragraphs.zh: 一种受控比较方法。 LRAB（第 4 节）保持模型、机器、后端、预算和评分不变，仅改变测试框架；我们将该基准明确界定为一个受控实验，而非排行榜，同时一并发布任务设定、评分代码以及完整的数据集。

paragraphs.en: 288-cell results. Mingbird 0.886 overall vs. 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), 0.405 (agent-mini); per-model, Mingbird is the only harness without a small-model cliff (2B: 0.821 vs. 0.017–0.271; a second small-tier family run through all four harnesses reproduces the pattern at 0.779 vs. 0.017–0.239), and it leads the long-horizon segment at 0.827 (single draw per cell; Section 5 ).

paragraphs.en: External validation. On τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, all three domains (retail, airline, telecom) run under one protocol: over the 278 scored tasks, Mingbird totals 0.856 vs. 0.791 (native agent) and 0.737 (opencode), derived, with the near-saturated telecom domain reported as such and the fourth CLI arm (goose) deferred for throughput (Section 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 外部验证。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 上，所有三个领域（零售、航空和电信）均遵循同一协议运行：在 278 个评分任务中，Mingbird 的总分为 0.856，而原生智能体为 0.791，opencode 为 0.737。该结果已得出；其中，接近饱和的电信领域按此报告，而第四个 CLI 分支（goose）因吞吐量问题被推迟处理（第 5.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism-level evidence. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation at 2B ( n = 18 n=18 per arm, same code base) covers three mechanisms (M1, the two halves of M3, and M4) across four variant arms and yields directional marginal effects (removing the finish gate reduces the total by 0.098; the flat prefill is near-neutral on this task set at 2B; Section 5.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 机制层证据。 在 2B（每臂 n = 18，代码基础相同）上进行的“排除一个机制”的消融分析涵盖了四个变体臂中的三种机制（M1、M3 的两个部分以及 M4），并得出了有方向性的边际效应（移除结束门会使总量减少 0.098；平坦预填充在此任务集 2B 上的影响接近中性；第 5.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: We are explicit about what this paper is not. It proposes no new algorithm; the model, the backend, and the prompts are ordinary. The contribution is systems engineering: identifying which harness behaviors break small models and showing that fixing them moves measured outcomes by large margins.
paragraphs.zh: 我们明确说明了本文并非要探讨的内容。 本文没有提出任何新算法；其模型、后端和提示词都是普通的。 本文的贡献在于系统工程：识别哪些运行行为会破坏小型模型，并证明修复这些行为能显著提升衡量指标的结果。

sents.en: The contribution is systems engineering: identifying which harness behaviors break small models and showing that fixing them moves measured outcomes by large margins.

paragraphs.en: The dominant agent recipe descends from ReAct [ 16 ] : the model interleaves free-form reasoning with tool calls in a loop, and the harness executes each call and appends the observation. Toolformer [ 17 ] demonstrated that models can learn when to call APIs; Gorilla [ 18 ] fine-tunes specifically for accurate API invocation and motivated the function-calling interfaces now exposed by most inference providers. Around this core, a body of work improves the model’s behavior inside the loop: Reflexion [ 19 ] stores verbal self-critiques across attempts, and Self-Refine [ 20 ] iterates on its own outputs. These techniques presuppose exactly what small models lack, namely the ability to produce a usable critique of one’s own attempt. Mingbird therefore concentrates on the harness side: it does not ask the model to self-improve in the abstract; it changes what the model sees, when it is allowed to stop, and what happens after each malformed step. Anthropic’s engineering guidance [ 21 ] distinguishes workflows (predefined code paths) from agents (the model directs its own process); Mingbird is an agent in that sense, but with harness-enforced guardrails at the points where small models demonstrably fail.
paragraphs.zh: 主流智能体方案源自 ReAct [ 16 ]：模型在循环中交替进行自由形式的推理和工具调用，而执行框架则执行每次调用并附加观察结果。 Toolformer [ 17 ] 证明了模型能够学会何时调用 API；Gorilla [ 18 ] 则专门针对精确的 API 调用进行了微调，并推动了当前大多数推理提供商所提供的函数调用接口。 围绕这一核心，一系列研究致力于改进模型在循环内的行为：Reflexion [ 19 ] 将语言形式的自我批评存储于不同尝试之间，而 Self-Refine [ 20 ] 则对自身输出进行迭代优化。 这些技术恰恰预设了小型模型所缺乏的能力，即对自身尝试生成可用批评的能力。 因此，Mingbird 专注于执行框架层面：它不要求模型抽象地进行自我改进，而是改变模型所见的内容、允许其停止的时机，以及每次步骤出错后会发生什么。 Anthropic 的工程指南 [ 21 ] 区分了工作流（预定义的代码路径）和智能体（模型自主引导其过程）；从这个意义上说，Mingbird 是一种智能体，但在小型模型明显失效的关键节点上，它通过执行框架施加了约束机制。

paragraphs.en: AgentBench [ 22 ] and AgentBoard [ 23 ] evaluate multi-turn agents across many environments, the latter with analytical progress metrics rather than final success only. WebArena [ 24 ] builds a reproducible web environment; SWE-bench [ 25 ] scores real GitHub issue resolution; GAIA [ 26 ] scores general assistant questions that are easy for humans. Closest to our external validation are τ \tau -bench [ 27 ] and τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench [ 15 ] : a user simulator converses with an agent that must operate domain tools under policy, and scoring verifies the final database state, so an agent that bypasses its tool stream cannot score. LRAB differs from all of these in intent: it is not meant to rank models but to isolate harness effects under a fully published protocol, which is why it uses one machine, one backend, and per-cell deterministic artifact scoring.
paragraphs.zh: AgentBench [ 22 ] 和 AgentBoard [ 23 ] 用于评估多轮智能体在多种环境中的表现，其中后者采用分析性进展指标，而不仅仅是最终成功与否。 WebArena [ 24 ] 构建了一个可复现的网页环境；SWE-bench [ 25 ] 对真实 GitHub 问题的解决能力进行评分；GAIA [ 26 ] 则针对人类容易回答的一般性助手问题进行评分。 与我们外部验证最接近的是 τ \tau -bench [ 27 ] 和 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench [ 15 ]：一个用户模拟器与智能体进行对话，该智能体必须在策略约束下操作领域工具，评分则通过验证最终数据库状态来实现，因此任何绕过其工具流程的智能体都无法获得分数。 LRAB 在这些测试中的意图完全不同：它并非用于对模型进行排名，而是旨在通过完全公开的协议隔离测试框架的影响，因此它采用单台机器、单一后端以及每个单元格确定性的产物评分方式。

paragraphs.en: llama.cpp [ 6 ] established efficient CPU/GPU inference for quantized open models, and Ollama [ 5 ] packages it with model management and a serving API. Surveys of small language models [ 1 ] document the on-device latency and memory envelope, and data-centric efforts such as SmolLM2 [ 2 ] and the Gemma and Qwen families [ 3 , 28 ] push capability per parameter. This line of work improves the model side of the local stack. The harness side, however, has largely been ported from cloud practice: lightweight libraries such as smolagents [ 29 ] and Open Interpreter [ 30 ] make small models drivable with minimal scaffolding; function-calling at the edge has been explored directly [ 7 ] ; and the full harnesses we test against (goose [ 12 ] , opencode [ 14 ] , agent-mini [ 13 ] ) are designed around large-context cloud models and Unix-family shells. Mingbird starts from the opposite end: 2–9B models, a Windows host, an integrated GPU, and tasks that mix code, files, and research.
paragraphs.zh: llama.cpp [ 6 ] 为量化开放模型建立了高效的 CPU/GPU 推理能力，而 Ollama [ 5 ] 则将其与模型管理和服务 API 整合在一起。 关于小型语言模型的综述 [ 1 ] 记录了设备端的延迟和内存限制，而以数据为中心的努力，例如 SmolLM2 [ 2 ] 以及 Gemma 和 Qwen 系列模型 [ 3 , 28 ]，则在提升单位参数的能力方面取得了进展。 这一系列工作优化了本地技术栈中的模型部分。 然而，工具层在很大程度上是从云端实践移植而来的：像 smolagents [ 29 ] 和 Open Interpreter [ 30 ] 这样的轻量级库使得小型模型无需复杂架构即可运行；边缘端的函数调用也已被直接探索 [ 7 ]；而我们所测试的完整工具集（goose [ 12 ]、opencode [ 14 ]、agent-mini [ 13 ]）则是围绕大上下文云端模型和类 Unix 外壳设计的。 Mingbird 则从另一端出发：使用 2–9B 模型、Windows 主机、集成 GPU，以及结合代码、文件和研究的混合任务。

paragraphs.en: SWE-agent [ 31 ] showed that the agent–computer interface (the shape of the tools an agent is given) changes measured performance on SWE-bench; our results agree and extend the observation to model-scale effects. OpenHands [ 32 ] is a general platform for software-development agents. Cline [ 33 ] and aider [ 34 ] embed agents in editors and git workflows. These systems target strong models (cloud APIs or large local checkpoints), assume a POSIX-flavored command environment, and optimize for coding tasks. Mingbird is complementary: it targets the under-served regime where the model is small, the machine is a consumer laptop, and the platform is Windows, and it treats harness mechanisms for small-model failure forms as the primary design object.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-agent [ 31 ] 的研究表明，智能体与计算机的接口（即智能体所获得的工具形态）会影响其在 SWE-bench 上的表现；我们的研究结果与此一致，并将这一观察延伸至模型规模的影响。 OpenHands [ 32 ] 是一个面向软件开发智能体的通用平台。 Cline [ 33 ] 和 aider [ 34 ] 将智能体嵌入到编辑器和 git 工作流中。 这些系统针对强大的模型（云端 API 或大型本地检查点），假设使用 POSIX 风格的命令环境，并针对编码任务进行优化。 Mingbird 则与之互补：它面向一个尚未得到充分服务的场景——模型规模较小、设备为消费级笔记本电脑、平台为 Windows，并将小型模型失效形式的处理机制作为其首要的设计对象。

sents.en: SWE-agent [ 31 ] showed that the agent–computer interface (the shape of the tools an agent is given) changes measured performance on SWE-bench; our results agree and extend the observation to model-scale effects.

paragraphs.en: That the harness, not only the model, drives measured agent performance is an active 2026 result, not our discovery. Zhang et al. [ 35 ] name and test the binding-constraint thesis — harness configuration dominates model choice as a source of performance variance — and call for mandatory harness disclosure; Starace [ 36 ] pre-registers a three-scaffold, five-model comparison on GAIA and finds within-model scaffold effects up to 28 points; the CAIS Arena benchmark [ 37 ] pins a single model across six agent frameworks on one MCP tool server. Our contribution is complementary and at a tier none of these cover: we instantiate the thesis with 2–9B local weights on Windows/Ollama, and decompose it at the mechanism level — a reusable inventory of small-model failure forms with the harness mechanism that addresses each, and measured per-mechanism costs and deltas. For loop detection specifically, OpenHands’ StuckDetector [ 32 ] normalizes events and counts repeated action–observation ( ≥ \geq 4), action–error ( ≥ \geq 3), monologue, and alternation patterns with intervention nudges; our M4 follows that detection paradigm and adds signature normalization over tool name plus arguments, a tiered escalation ladder, and a CI-enforced regression tie. What we claim as new at this scale is narrower: a net-zero prefill budget enforced byte-level in CI, and a completion gate that re-reads the task text before accepting “done” — both aimed at the 2–9B tier where, per our measurements, prefill crowding and false finishes are the dominant failure forms. A complementary line treats the harness itself as the design object: Agentless [ 38 ] shows that a deliberately narrow scaffold can outperform agentic ones on software-engineering tasks; ADAS [ 39 ] , AFlow [ 40 ] , GPTSwarm [ 41 ] , and DSPy [ 42 ] search, compile, or optimize harness structure automatically; and ToolLLM [ 43 ] routes over large API spaces with a learned retriever. Our category router is a static, zero-training counterpart of that retrieval idea, and our mechanism set is hand-designed rather than searched — a choice Section 5.6 quantifies mechanism by mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 不仅是模型，就连测试框架本身也会影响智能体的可衡量性能，这一结论是2026年的一项主动研究结果，而非我们的发现。Zhang等人 [ 35 ] 对“绑定约束理论”进行了命名和验证——即测试框架的配置比模型选择更能决定性能差异——并呼吁强制披露测试框架信息；Starace [ 36 ] 在GAIA上预先注册了一项包含三种架构和五种模型的对比实验，发现同一模型内不同架构的性能差异最高可达28分；CAIS Arena基准测试 [ 37 ] 则在一个MCP工具服务器上对单一模型进行了六种智能体框架的测试。 我们的贡献具有补充性，且处于这些研究均未覆盖的层级：我们在Windows/Ollama环境下使用2–9B本地权重实例化了该理论，并从机制层面对其进行了分解——提供了一套可复用的“小型模型失效形式”清单，其中每种失效形式都对应特定的测试框架机制，并给出了各机制的具体成本与差异数据。 在循环检测方面，OpenHands的StuckDetector [ 32 ] 对事件进行了标准化处理，并通过干预提示来统计重复的动作–观察（≥ \geq 4）、动作–错误（≥ \geq 3）、独白及交替模式；我们的M4遵循了这种检测范式，并额外增加了工具名称与参数组合的签名标准化、分级升级流程以及由CI强制执行的回归绑定机制。 我们在此规模下声称的新贡献更为具体：在CI中强制实施字节级精确的净零预填充预算，以及在完成判断前重新读取任务文本的完成门控——这两项措施均针对2–9B层级，因为根据我们的测量结果，预填充拥挤和虚假完成是该层级的主要失效形式。 另一条补充路线则将测试框架本身视为设计对象：Agentless [ 38 ] 表明，刻意设计的狭窄架构在软件工程任务中可能优于通用智能体架构；ADAS [ 39 ]、AFlow [ 40 ]、GPTSwarm [ 41 ] 和DSPy [ 42 ] 能够自动搜索、编译或优化测试框架结构；而ToolLLM [ 43 ] 则通过一个学习型检索器在庞大的API空间中路由工具调用。 我们的类别路由器是上述检索思路的一种静态、无需训练的对应方案，而我们的机制集合则是人工设计的而非自动搜索所得——这一选择在第5.6节中按机制进行了量化分析。

paragraphs.en: Mingbird is a local-first agent harness: everything (model, tools, speech recognition, memory) runs on the user’s machine (the only optional outbound endpoint is a user-configured search provider), and the harness adds no inference overhead of its own. This section describes the v1.6.0 release; all measurements reported in this paper were taken on v1.5.0, and the two releases differ by 23 static-prefill tokens (774 vs. 797; Appendix B ). Figure 1 shows the architecture. A GUI (bilingual, built on ttkbootstrap) and a CLI front the same agent loop. Per turn, the loop assembles a flat prefill through a task-domain router (M1), classifies the request as chat or task (M2), executes tool calls through a sandboxed executor with edit safety (M6) and security boundaries (M8), monitors loop signatures (M4), and enforces a finish gate before any completion claim leaves the system (M3). A resilience layer (M7) absorbs encoding faults, empty turns, and process kills via checkpoints. The backend is whatever Ollama serves, with automatic model detection and a default 128K context (up to 256K).
paragraphs.zh: Mingbird 是一种本地优先的智能体框架：所有组件（模型、工具、语音识别、记忆）都在用户的机器上运行（唯一可选的外部端点是用户配置的搜索提供商），且该框架本身不会增加任何推理开销。 本节介绍 v1.6.0 版本；本文报告的所有测量数据均基于 v1.5.0 版本，两个版本之间相差 23 个静态预填充令牌（774 对比 797；见附录 B）。 图 1 展示了其架构。 一个图形用户界面（双语，基于 ttkbootstrap 构建）和一个命令行界面共同面向同一个智能体循环。 在每个回合中，该循环通过任务领域路由器（M1）组装一个扁平的预填充，将请求分类为聊天或任务（M2），通过带有编辑安全机制（M6）和安全边界（M8）的沙盒执行器执行工具调用，监控循环特征（M4），并在任何完成声明离开系统前强制执行结束门控（M3）。 一个弹性层（M7）可通过检查点吸收编码故障、空回合和进程终止。 后端由 Ollama 提供的任意服务组成，支持自动模型检测，并默认使用 128K 上下文长度（最高可达 256K）。

paragraphs.en: Two quantities bound the resource footprint. The factory prefill (everything static the model sees before any task content) is 797 tokens in the current release, pinned by a unit test rather than allowed to drift. The quality base is 441 tests at the documented v1.6.0 (461 at the v1.8.2 tag current at writing; repository test counts and their unit/integration split are stated in the README), including a regression assertion that any change to the codebase must keep the static prefill at exactly zero net growth, checked byte-for-byte. The rest of this section expands each mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 两个量界定了资源占用范围。 工厂预填充（模型在接触任何任务内容之前所看到的所有静态内容）在当前版本中为 797 个词元，这一数值通过单元测试固定下来，而非允许其浮动。 质量基准是在已记录的 v1.6.0 版本中包含的 441 项测试（截至撰写时，v1.8.2 标签版本包含 461 项测试；仓库中的测试数量及其单元/集成测试划分在 README 中有说明），其中包括一项回归断言：对代码库的任何修改都必须确保静态预填充的净增长严格为零，且需逐字节验证。 本节的其余部分将详细阐述每种机制。

sents.zh: 表 1 将每种机制与其所针对的故障形式对应起来。

sents.zh: 各小节提供了详细信息和权衡分析。

paragraphs.en: A 2–9B model given a cloud-style tool manifest (a few dozen JSON schemas with descriptions) spends several thousand tokens before the task begins. In our pre-benchmark runs we observed instruction-following degrade once a large, weakly relevant schema block preceded the task; in the worst case the context is substantially spent before the first user sentence. This matches the published input-length evidence: reasoning degrades when the same task is padded with more tokens [ 44 ] , and frontier models lose accuracy long before their context window fills [ 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个 2–9B 模型在接收到云风格工具清单（包含几十个带描述的 JSON 模式）后，在任务开始前就已消耗了数千个 token。 在我们的预基准测试运行中，我们观察到，一旦一个庞大且相关性较弱的模式块出现在任务之前，指令遵循能力就会下降；在最坏情况下，上下文在第一条用户语句出现前就已经被大量消耗。 这与已发表的输入长度证据一致：当同一任务被填充更多 token 时，推理能力会下降 [44]，而前沿模型在上下文窗口填满之前很久就会失去准确性 [45]。

paragraphs.en: The harness classifies the task domain first and loads only the tool definitions relevant to that category, in a flat (non-nested) format. The factory prefill is 797 tokens, pinned by a unit test (v1.6.0). MCP tools [ 46 ] are injected through the same mechanism: category-routed, flat, with compressed schemas (parameters beyond eight are trimmed to required ones). The binding constraint is a hard budget: any new feature must add zero net static prefill , enforced by a byte-level regression assertion in CI (M10).
paragraphs.zh: 该框架首先对任务领域进行分类，然后仅以扁平（非嵌套）格式加载与该类别相关的工具定义。 工厂预填充为 797 个词元，由单元测试（v1.6.0）锁定。 MCP 工具 [ 46 ] 通过同一机制注入：按类别路由、扁平化，并使用压缩模式（超过八个的参数会被裁剪至仅保留必要参数）。 绑定约束是一个硬性预算：任何新功能都必须不增加净静态预填充量，该约束通过 CI 中的字节级回归断言强制执行（M10）。

sents.en: The harness classifies the task domain first and loads only the tool definitions relevant to that category, in a flat (non-nested) format.
sents.zh: 该框架首先对任务领域进行分类，然后仅以扁平（非嵌套）格式加载与该类别相关的工具定义。

sents.en: The factory prefill is 797 tokens, pinned by a unit test (v1.6.0).
sents.zh: 工厂预填充为 797 个词元，由单元测试（v1.6.0）锁定。

sents.en: MCP tools [ 46 ] are injected through the same mechanism: category-routed, flat, with compressed schemas (parameters beyond eight are trimmed to required ones).
sents.zh: MCP 工具 [ 46 ] 通过同一机制注入：按类别路由、扁平化，并使用压缩模式（超过八个的参数会被裁剪至仅保留必要参数）。

sents.zh: 绑定约束是一个硬性预算：任何新功能都必须不增加净静态预填充量，该约束通过 CI 中的字节级回归断言强制执行（M10）。

paragraphs.en: Category routing can misclassify and hide a tool the task needs; the classifier is deliberately conservative and the task can request re-routing. The net-zero rule forces every new capability to be paid for by removing or compressing something else, a constraint that binds at small scale, where prefill tokens compete directly with task context, and that larger models absorb without measurable cost.
paragraphs.zh: 类别路由可能会错误分类并隐藏任务所需的工具；分类器是故意保守设计的，而任务可以请求重新路由。 净零规则要求每一项新能力都必须通过移除或压缩其他内容来实现，这一限制在小规模场景下尤为明显——此时预填充标记会与任务上下文直接竞争，而大型模型则能吸收这些内容且不会产生可测量的成本。

sents.en: Category routing can misclassify and hide a tool the task needs; the classifier is deliberately conservative and the task can request re-routing.
sents.zh: 类别路由可能会错误分类并隐藏任务所需的工具；分类器是故意保守设计的，而任务可以请求重新路由。

sents.en: The net-zero rule forces every new capability to be paid for by removing or compressing something else, a constraint that binds at small scale, where prefill tokens compete directly with task context, and that larger models absorb without measurable cost.
sents.zh: 净零规则要求每一项新能力都必须通过移除或压缩其他内容来实现，这一限制在小规模场景下尤为明显——此时预填充标记会与任务上下文直接竞争，而大型模型则能吸收这些内容且不会产生可测量的成本。

paragraphs.en: On the benchmark machine’s integrated GPU we measured prompt-processing time as a function of the injected tool-surface width: real schemas from a clean bench instance and a full user configuration (18 built-in + 13 MCP tools), duplicated and renamed up to 256 tools, median of three runs with a per-request nonce to defeat prefix caching (payloads extracted from the product tree of 2026-09-20; see Appendix B for the version map). The cost grows linearly at the 4B tier ( ∼ 0.20 {\sim}0.20 ms per prefill token: 1.5 s at 19 tools, 1.7 s at the 31-tool full configuration, 5.6 s at 256 tools; Figure 2 ) and super-linearly at 2B, where 256 tools cost 33.6 s of prefill per turn — twenty turns would burn eleven minutes before any generation. The router’s own constant overhead, +330 tokens (measured directly: first-turn prompt count 1269 with M1 disabled against 1596 with it enabled, on the same tasks and model), is part of the 797-token static prefill of the documented v1.6.0 — 774 tokens in the v1.5.0 tree the matrix measured, Appendix B — 41.4% of the former and 42.6% of the latter: a real cost that the M1 design must acknowledge, and on the same curve’s local slope near the working point it costs 68 ms (4B) to 217 ms (2B) per turn — the mechanism that pins the working point to the left edge of this curve is nearly free.
paragraphs.zh: 在基准机器的集成 GPU 上，我们测量了提示处理时间与注入的工具表面宽度之间的关系：使用干净基准实例和完整用户配置（18 个内置工具 + 13 个 MCP 工具）的真实模式，将其复制并重命名为多达 256 个工具，并在每次请求中使用随机数以避免前缀缓存，取三次运行的中位数（负载数据提取自 2026-09-20 的产品树；版本映射参见附录 B）。 在 4B 层级上，成本呈线性增长（每预填充令牌约 0.20 {\sim}0.20 毫秒：19 个工具时耗时 1.5 秒，31 个工具的完整配置耗时 1.7 秒，256 个工具时耗时 5.6 秒；见图 2），而在 2B 层级则呈超线性增长，此时 256 个工具每次轮次需要 33.6 秒的预填充时间——二十轮次将在任何生成开始前就消耗十一分钟。 路由器自身的固定开销（+330 个令牌，直接测量得出：在相同任务和模型下，禁用 M1 时首轮提示数量为 1269，启用 M1 时为 1596）是文档中 v1.6.0 版本 797 个静态预填充令牌的一部分——矩阵测得的 v1.5.0 树中为 774 个令牌（附录 B），分别占前者 41.4% 和后者 42.6%：这是 M1 设计必须承认的实际成本，并且在同一曲线工作点附近的局部斜率上，每次轮次的成本为 68 毫秒（4B）至 217 毫秒（2B）——将工作点固定在该曲线左边缘的机制几乎不产生额外成本。

paragraphs.en: A user asks a casual question (“what can you do?”) and a small model, seeing the full toolset, answers by demonstrating : it calls tools, narrates, calls more tools, and enters an open-ended loop, which we term the tool-demonstration loop . The same model given a task rarely does this.
paragraphs.zh: 当用户提出一个随意的问题（“你能做什么？”）时，一个小模型在看到完整的工具集后，会通过演示来回答：它会调用工具、进行叙述、再次调用更多工具，并进入一个开放式的循环，我们称之为工具演示循环。 同样的模型在被赋予任务时，很少会这样做。

sents.en: A user asks a casual question (“what can you do?”) and a small model, seeing the full toolset, answers by demonstrating : it calls tools, narrates, calls more tools, and enters an open-ended loop, which we term the tool-demonstration loop .
sents.zh: 当用户提出一个随意的问题（“你能做什么？”）时，一个小模型在看到完整的工具集后，会通过演示来回答：它会调用工具、进行叙述、再次调用更多工具，并进入一个开放式的循环，我们称之为工具演示循环。

sents.en: The same model given a task rarely does this.
sents.zh: 同样的模型在被赋予任务时，很少会这样做。

paragraphs.en: Requests are classified into chat and task. Chat uses a minimal chat-level prefill and the loop terminates once the answer is delivered; the model is not offered a continuation. Task mode unlocks the full toolset. A short follow-up instruction appended to a conversation that has produced artifacts is recognized as task continuation. This rule is what keeps multi-step repair pipelines (e.g. the todo-list repair flow) coherent.
paragraphs.zh: 请求被分为聊天和任务两类。 聊天模式使用最简的聊天级预填充，一旦答案送达循环即终止；模型不会被提供继续生成的机会。 任务模式会解锁全部工具集。 在已生成产出的对话中附加简短的后续指令，会被识别为任务延续。 正是这条规则确保了多步骤修复流程（例如待办事项修复流程）的连贯性。

sents.en: Requests are classified into chat and task.
sents.zh: 请求被分为聊天和任务两类。

sents.en: Chat uses a minimal chat-level prefill and the loop terminates once the answer is delivered; the model is not offered a continuation.
sents.zh: 聊天模式使用最简的聊天级预填充，一旦答案送达循环即终止；模型不会被提供继续生成的机会。

sents.en: Task mode unlocks the full toolset.
sents.zh: 任务模式会解锁全部工具集。

sents.en: A short follow-up instruction appended to a conversation that has produced artifacts is recognized as task continuation.
sents.zh: 在已生成产出的对话中附加简短的后续指令，会被识别为任务延续。

sents.en: This rule is what keeps multi-step repair pipelines (e.g. the todo-list repair flow) coherent.
sents.zh: 正是这条规则确保了多步骤修复流程（例如待办事项修复流程）的连贯性。

paragraphs.en: Misrouting a genuine task into chat mode would strand it without tools, so the classifier errs toward task mode whenever an artifact-producing history exists. The layering trades a single unified loop for two simple, separately testable ones.
paragraphs.zh: 将真正的任务错误地引导至聊天模式，会导致其因缺少工具而无法继续执行，因此只要存在能生成产物的历史，分类器就会倾向于选择任务模式。 这种分层设计用一个统一的循环，换取了两个简单且可单独测试的循环。

sents.en: Misrouting a genuine task into chat mode would strand it without tools, so the classifier errs toward task mode whenever an artifact-producing history exists.
sents.zh: 将真正的任务错误地引导至聊天模式，会导致其因缺少工具而无法继续执行，因此只要存在能生成产物的历史，分类器就会倾向于选择任务模式。

sents.en: The layering trades a single unified loop for two simple, separately testable ones.
sents.zh: 这种分层设计用一个统一的循环，换取了两个简单且可单独测试的循环。

paragraphs.en: Small models abandon tasks silently: they emit a message that reads as a completion claim while the required artifacts are missing or incomplete. Longer plans suffer a related drift, because after context compression the plan text itself is gone and the model continues from a summary that has lost the acceptance criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 小型模型会悄无声息地放弃任务：它们会发出一个看似已完成声明的消息，但所需的产物却缺失或不完整。 更长的计划也会出现类似的偏差，因为在上下文压缩之后，计划文本本身已经消失，而模型则继续基于一个丢失了验收标准的摘要进行执行。

sents.en: Small models abandon tasks silently: they emit a message that reads as a completion claim while the required artifacts are missing or incomplete.
sents.zh: 小型模型会悄无声息地放弃任务：它们会发出一个看似已完成声明的消息，但所需的产物却缺失或不完整。

sents.en: Longer plans suffer a related drift, because after context compression the plan text itself is gone and the model continues from a summary that has lost the acceptance criteria.
sents.zh: 更长的计划也会出现类似的偏差，因为在上下文压缩之后，计划文本本身已经消失，而模型则继续基于一个丢失了验收标准的摘要进行执行。

paragraphs.en: Before any completion claim is accepted, the harness re-reads the original task text and asks the model to verify delivery against it, point by point. The todo/plan pipeline re-injects the plan verbatim after compression, and the todo interface exposes an explicit completion exit ( todo(update, all=true) ) so that completion is an explicit action rather than a stylistic drift. The gate’s verification step runs the task’s own checks and feeds real failures (file, line, error text) back into the conversation; we refer to this loop as the verification-feedback mechanism in the ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何完成声明被接受之前，测试框架会重新阅读原始任务文本，并要求模型逐点对比验证交付结果是否符合该文本。 todo/plan 流程在压缩后会原样重新注入计划，同时 todo 接口会提供一个明确的完成退出点（todo(update, all=true)），使“完成”成为一个显式操作，而非风格上的偏移。 关卡的验证步骤会执行任务自身的检查，并将实际的失败信息（文件、行号、错误文本）反馈到对话中；在消融实验中，我们将这一循环称为验证-反馈机制。

sents.en: Before any completion claim is accepted, the harness re-reads the original task text and asks the model to verify delivery against it, point by point.
sents.zh: 在任何完成声明被接受之前，测试框架会重新阅读原始任务文本，并要求模型逐点对比验证交付结果是否符合该文本。

sents.en: The todo/plan pipeline re-injects the plan verbatim after compression, and the todo interface exposes an explicit completion exit ( todo(update, all=true) ) so that completion is an explicit action rather than a stylistic drift.
sents.zh: todo/plan 流程在压缩后会原样重新注入计划，同时 todo 接口会提供一个明确的完成退出点（todo(update, all=true)），使“完成”成为一个显式操作，而非风格上的偏移。

sents.en: The gate’s verification step runs the task’s own checks and feeds real failures (file, line, error text) back into the conversation; we refer to this loop as the verification-feedback mechanism in the ablation.
sents.zh: 关卡的验证步骤会执行任务自身的检查，并将实际的失败信息（文件、行号、错误文本）反馈到对话中；在消融实验中，我们将这一循环称为验证-反馈机制。

paragraphs.en: The gate costs one extra model turn per task. It also cannot force a model to produce a correct self-check; what it forces is a second pass in which the task text is in context, which in our runs was sufficient to convert most silent abandonments into either completion or an articulated blocker.
paragraphs.zh: 该门每执行一项任务会额外消耗一个模型轮次。 它也无法强制模型生成正确的自我检查；它所能强制的是进行第二轮处理，此时任务文本已处于上下文之中，而在我们的运行中，这足以将大多数无声放弃转化为完成或明确的阻碍说明。

sents.en: The gate costs one extra model turn per task.
sents.zh: 该门每执行一项任务会额外消耗一个模型轮次。

sents.en: It also cannot force a model to produce a correct self-check; what it forces is a second pass in which the task text is in context, which in our runs was sufficient to convert most silent abandonments into either completion or an articulated blocker.
sents.zh: 它也无法强制模型生成正确的自我检查；它所能强制的是进行第二轮处理，此时任务文本已处于上下文之中，而在我们的运行中，这足以将大多数无声放弃转化为完成或明确的阻碍说明。

paragraphs.en: A small model repeats the same tool call with the same arguments (10, 50, 150 times) producing no artifacts. In one pre-benchmark case (4B model, task WF-08), the pre-fix run made 156 tool calls and produced 0 artifacts; we return to this case as motivation below.
paragraphs.zh: 一个小模型重复使用相同的工具调用和相同的参数（10、50、150 次），但没有生成任何产物。 在一个基准测试前的案例中（4B 模型，任务 WF-08），预处理运行执行了 156 次工具调用，但生成了 0 个产物；我们将在下文回到这个案例作为动机说明。

sents.en: A small model repeats the same tool call with the same arguments (10, 50, 150 times) producing no artifacts.
sents.zh: 一个小模型重复使用相同的工具调用和相同的参数（10、50、150 次），但没有生成任何产物。

sents.en: In one pre-benchmark case (4B model, task WF-08), the pre-fix run made 156 tool calls and produced 0 artifacts; we return to this case as motivation below.
sents.zh: 在一个基准测试前的案例中（4B 模型，任务 WF-08），预处理运行执行了 156 次工具调用，但生成了 0 个产物；我们将在下文回到这个案例作为动机说明。

paragraphs.en: The harness computes a call signature (tool plus normalized arguments) and trips at ≥ 6 \geq 6 identical calls or ≥ 15 \geq 15 consecutive calls with no output. Escalation is graduated: the third rejection carries a strong corrective hint, and six consecutive empty turns trigger a hard reset of the turn; a v1.5.0 reachability fix ensures that alternating partial-output debris and empty turns no longer reset the escalation counters. After the fix, the same 4B × \times WF-08 configuration completed in 15 tool calls with 3 artifacts, with the prefill bit-identical before and after. This is a single-task motivating case, not controlled evidence; the controlled ablation appears in Section 5.6 . Two adjacent failure modes are guarded separately. The output cap was raised from 2048 to 8192 tokens in v1.5.0: at 2048, the emission of a large file is truncated mid-body and the run decays into an empty-turn spiral; a truncation signature now returns skeleton-plus-append feedback so the model can continue in chunks. File reading obeys a byte-budget crawl guard (v2). The budget is clamped to twice the file size, between 64 KB and 512 KB. The guard never refuses outright; past the budget it returns the first 2000 characters of the requested range with the position preserved, so that crawling can continue rather than restart.
paragraphs.zh: 该约束机制会计算一个调用签名（工具加上归一化参数），并在出现 ≥6 次相同调用或 ≥15 次无输出的连续调用时触发。 升级机制是逐步进行的：第三次拒绝会附带一个强烈的纠正提示，而六次连续的无效回合则会强制重置回合状态；v1.5.0 版本中的一项可达性修复确保了部分输出碎片与无效回合交替出现时不再重置升级计数器。 修复后，相同的 4B × WF-08 配置以 15 次工具调用和 3 个产物完成，且前后预填充的比特完全一致。 这是一个单一任务的激励性案例，而非受控证据；受控消融分析见第 5.6 节。 两种相邻的故障模式被分别防护。 在 v1.5.0 版本中，输出上限从 2048 提升至 8192 个词元：在 2048 的限制下，大文件的输出会在中部被截断，运行过程会退化为无效回合的循环；现在截断签名会返回骨架加附加内容的反馈，使模型能够分块继续处理。 文件读取遵循字节预算的爬行防护机制（v2）。 该预算被限制为文件大小两倍，范围在 64 KB 到 512 KB 之间。 该防护机制绝不会直接拒绝；超出预算时，它会返回所请求范围内的前 2000 个字符并保留位置信息，以便爬行过程能够继续而非重新开始。

sents.en: The harness computes a call signature (tool plus normalized arguments) and trips at ≥ 6 \geq 6 identical calls or ≥ 15 \geq 15 consecutive calls with no output.
sents.zh: 该约束机制会计算一个调用签名（工具加上归一化参数），并在出现 ≥6 次相同调用或 ≥15 次无输出的连续调用时触发。

sents.en: Escalation is graduated: the third rejection carries a strong corrective hint, and six consecutive empty turns trigger a hard reset of the turn; a v1.5.0 reachability fix ensures that alternating partial-output debris and empty turns no longer reset the escalation counters.
sents.zh: 升级机制是逐步进行的：第三次拒绝会附带一个强烈的纠正提示，而六次连续的无效回合则会强制重置回合状态；v1.5.0 版本中的一项可达性修复确保了部分输出碎片与无效回合交替出现时不再重置升级计数器。

sents.en: After the fix, the same 4B × \times WF-08 configuration completed in 15 tool calls with 3 artifacts, with the prefill bit-identical before and after.
sents.zh: 修复后，相同的 4B × WF-08 配置以 15 次工具调用和 3 个产物完成，且前后预填充的比特完全一致。

sents.en: This is a single-task motivating case, not controlled evidence; the controlled ablation appears in Section 5.6 .
sents.zh: 这是一个单一任务的激励性案例，而非受控证据；受控消融分析见第 5.6 节。

sents.en: Two adjacent failure modes are guarded separately.
sents.zh: 两种相邻的故障模式被分别防护。

sents.en: The output cap was raised from 2048 to 8192 tokens in v1.5.0: at 2048, the emission of a large file is truncated mid-body and the run decays into an empty-turn spiral; a truncation signature now returns skeleton-plus-append feedback so the model can continue in chunks.
sents.zh: 在 v1.5.0 版本中，输出上限从 2048 提升至 8192 个词元：在 2048 的限制下，大文件的输出会在中部被截断，运行过程会退化为无效回合的循环；现在截断签名会返回骨架加附加内容的反馈，使模型能够分块继续处理。

sents.en: File reading obeys a byte-budget crawl guard (v2).
sents.zh: 文件读取遵循字节预算的爬行防护机制（v2）。

sents.en: The budget is clamped to twice the file size, between 64 KB and 512 KB.
sents.zh: 该预算被限制为文件大小两倍，范围在 64 KB 到 512 KB 之间。

sents.en: The guard never refuses outright; past the budget it returns the first 2000 characters of the requested range with the position preserved, so that crawling can continue rather than restart.
sents.zh: 该防护机制绝不会直接拒绝；超出预算时，它会返回所请求范围内的前 2000 个字符并保留位置信息，以便爬行过程能够继续而非重新开始。

paragraphs.en: Any loop detector has false positives (legitimate iteration, e.g. re-running tests after each edit). Signatures normalize arguments, not raw text, and legitimate iteration usually changes inputs; the thresholds ( 6 6 , 15 15 ) were set well above observed legitimate repetition. When the detector does trip on legitimate work, the cost is one corrective prompt, not a terminated run.
paragraphs.zh: 任何循环检测器都存在误报（合法的迭代，例如每次编辑后重新运行测试）。 特征签名对参数进行标准化，而非原始文本，且合法迭代通常会改变输入；阈值（6 6、15 15）被设置得远高于观察到的合法重复情况。 当检测器确实因合法操作而触发时，其代价只是一个纠正性提示，而非运行终止。

sents.en: Any loop detector has false positives (legitimate iteration, e.g. re-running tests after each edit).
sents.zh: 任何循环检测器都存在误报（合法的迭代，例如每次编辑后重新运行测试）。

sents.en: Signatures normalize arguments, not raw text, and legitimate iteration usually changes inputs; the thresholds ( 6 6 , 15 15 ) were set well above observed legitimate repetition.
sents.zh: 特征签名对参数进行标准化，而非原始文本，且合法迭代通常会改变输入；阈值（6 6、15 15）被设置得远高于观察到的合法重复情况。

sents.en: When the detector does trip on legitimate work, the cost is one corrective prompt, not a terminated run.
sents.zh: 当检测器确实因合法操作而触发时，其代价只是一个纠正性提示，而非运行终止。

paragraphs.en: Two related failure modes affect output emission. First, the model claims completion without artifacts; this case is handled by the M3 gate, and M5 governs the content of the rejection. Second, the model emits a tool call as plain text — placeholder-quoted quasi-XML, a JSON snippet in prose, or a double-quoted pseudo-call — which a strict parser discards, collapsing the turn.
paragraphs.zh: 两种相关的失效模式会影响输出生成。 首先，模型声称已完成生成且没有异常内容；这种情况由 M3 门控机制处理，而 M5 则控制拒绝信息的内容。 其次，模型以纯文本形式输出工具调用——例如带占位符引号的类 XML 格式、散文形式的 JSON 片段，或双引号包裹的伪调用——严格的解析器会丢弃这些内容，从而导致对话轮次终止。

sents.en: Two related failure modes affect output emission.
sents.zh: 两种相关的失效模式会影响输出生成。

sents.en: First, the model claims completion without artifacts; this case is handled by the M3 gate, and M5 governs the content of the rejection.
sents.zh: 首先，模型声称已完成生成且没有异常内容；这种情况由 M3 门控机制处理，而 M5 则控制拒绝信息的内容。

sents.en: Second, the model emits a tool call as plain text — placeholder-quoted quasi-XML, a JSON snippet in prose, or a double-quoted pseudo-call — which a strict parser discards, collapsing the turn.
sents.zh: 其次，模型以纯文本形式输出工具调用——例如带占位符引号的类 XML 格式、散文形式的 JSON 片段，或双引号包裹的伪调用——严格的解析器会丢弃这些内容，从而导致对话轮次终止。

paragraphs.en: A rejected false-finish message always carries the next executable action, so the lowest-cost recovery path is embedded in the rejection itself. Malformed calls are rescued structurally: the harness recognizes three recurring shapes (placeholder-quoted, bare-JSON, and double-quoted pseudo-calls) and converts them into real calls. Strict schema enforcement is the standard alternative; grammar-constrained decoding engines [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] and schema-emission benchmarks [ 50 ] map its costs, and how much output-format restrictions cost a model is actively debated [ 51 ] ; for 2–9B models we adopt rescue-with-feedback instead of strict schema enforcement. Repeated same-signature emission after a rescue triggers a corrective hint.
paragraphs.zh: 被拒绝的虚假结束消息总是携带下一个可执行操作，因此成本最低的恢复路径已嵌入到拒绝信息本身中。 格式错误的调用会通过结构修复：框架能够识别三种重复出现的模式（占位符引号、裸 JSON 和双引号伪调用），并将其转换为真实调用。 严格的模式强制是标准的替代方案；语法受限的解码引擎 [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] 和模式生成基准测试 [ 50 ] 对其成本进行了量化，而输出格式限制对模型的具体影响仍在积极讨论中 [ 51 ] ；对于 2–9B 模型，我们采用“修复加反馈”策略，而非严格的模式强制。 在修复操作后重复生成相同签名的内容会触发纠正提示。

sents.en: A rejected false-finish message always carries the next executable action, so the lowest-cost recovery path is embedded in the rejection itself.
sents.zh: 被拒绝的虚假结束消息总是携带下一个可执行操作，因此成本最低的恢复路径已嵌入到拒绝信息本身中。

sents.en: Malformed calls are rescued structurally: the harness recognizes three recurring shapes (placeholder-quoted, bare-JSON, and double-quoted pseudo-calls) and converts them into real calls.
sents.zh: 格式错误的调用会通过结构修复：框架能够识别三种重复出现的模式（占位符引号、裸 JSON 和双引号伪调用），并将其转换为真实调用。

sents.en: Strict schema enforcement is the standard alternative; grammar-constrained decoding engines [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] and schema-emission benchmarks [ 50 ] map its costs, and how much output-format restrictions cost a model is actively debated [ 51 ] ; for 2–9B models we adopt rescue-with-feedback instead of strict schema enforcement.
sents.zh: 严格的模式强制是标准的替代方案；语法受限的解码引擎 [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] 和模式生成基准测试 [ 50 ] 对其成本进行了量化，而输出格式限制对模型的具体影响仍在积极讨论中 [ 51 ] ；对于 2–9B 模型，我们采用“修复加反馈”策略，而非严格的模式强制。

sents.en: Repeated same-signature emission after a rescue triggers a corrective hint.
sents.zh: 在修复操作后重复生成相同签名的内容会触发纠正提示。

paragraphs.en: Structural rescue is heuristic; a shape outside the three forms is rejected with feedback, and the harness does not attempt speculative parsing. We preferred a small, audited rescue set over a permissive parser that could execute something the model did not mean.
paragraphs.zh: 结构修复是启发式的；超出三种形式的形状会被反馈拒绝，而约束系统不会尝试推测性解析。 我们更倾向于一个经过审核的小型修复集，而不是一个宽松的解析器，后者可能会执行模型并未意图执行的内容。

sents.en: Structural rescue is heuristic; a shape outside the three forms is rejected with feedback, and the harness does not attempt speculative parsing.
sents.zh: 结构修复是启发式的；超出三种形式的形状会被反馈拒绝，而约束系统不会尝试推测性解析。

sents.en: We preferred a small, audited rescue set over a permissive parser that could execute something the model did not mean.
sents.zh: 我们更倾向于一个经过审核的小型修复集，而不是一个宽松的解析器，后者可能会执行模型并未意图执行的内容。

paragraphs.en: A small model overwrites a file with a bad edit and cannot recover; subsequent turns are then consumed by repair attempts, a regime in which 2–9B models perform particularly poorly.
paragraphs.zh: 一个小模型用错误的方式覆盖了文件，且无法恢复；此后的回合都消耗在修复尝试上，在这种模式下，2–9B 模型的表现尤其糟糕。

paragraphs.en: Every write automatically records a .bak backup; rollback is one command the model can issue itself. An edit convergence guard watches for alternating destructive edits.
paragraphs.zh: 每次写入都会自动记录一个 .bak 备份；回滚是模型可以自行发出的一个命令。 编辑收敛守卫会监测交替出现的破坏性编辑。

sents.en: Every write automatically records a .bak backup; rollback is one command the model can issue itself.
sents.zh: 每次写入都会自动记录一个 .bak 备份；回滚是模型可以自行发出的一个命令。

sents.en: An edit convergence guard watches for alternating destructive edits.
sents.zh: 编辑收敛守卫会监测交替出现的破坏性编辑。

paragraphs.en: .bak files accumulate in the working directory; they are excluded from artifact scoring and pruned on successful convergence. The mechanism is deliberately simple — no diffing, no merging — because simplicity is what makes it usable by the model itself as a recovery tool.
paragraphs.zh: .bak 文件会在工作目录中累积；它们不会被计入成果评分，并在成功收敛时被清理。 该机制的设计刻意保持简单——没有差异比较，也没有合并——因为正是这种简单性使其能够被模型本身用作恢复工具。

sents.en: .bak files accumulate in the working directory; they are excluded from artifact scoring and pruned on successful convergence.
sents.zh: .bak 文件会在工作目录中累积；它们不会被计入成果评分，并在成功收敛时被清理。

sents.en: The mechanism is deliberately simple — no diffing, no merging — because simplicity is what makes it usable by the model itself as a recovery tool.
sents.zh: 该机制的设计刻意保持简单——没有差异比较，也没有合并——因为正是这种简单性使其能够被模型本身用作恢复工具。

paragraphs.en: On Windows, process output arrives in legacy codepages (GBK among them); a strict UTF-8 reader crashes silently and the harness stalls with no diagnostic. Separately, models occasionally emit empty generations, and long runs are terminated (by the user, by power management, or by crashes) and were previously unrecoverable.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Windows 上，进程输出以旧版代码页（包括 GBK）的形式到达；严格的 UTF-8 读取器会静默崩溃，导致测试框架停滞且没有任何诊断信息。 此外，模型偶尔会生成空输出，而长时间运行的任务会被终止（由用户、电源管理或崩溃所致），并且此前无法恢复。

sents.en: On Windows, process output arrives in legacy codepages (GBK among them); a strict UTF-8 reader crashes silently and the harness stalls with no diagnostic.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上，进程输出以旧版代码页（包括 GBK）的形式到达；严格的 UTF-8 读取器会静默崩溃，导致测试框架停滞且没有任何诊断信息。

sents.en: Separately, models occasionally emit empty generations, and long runs are terminated (by the user, by power management, or by crashes) and were previously unrecoverable.
sents.zh: 此外，模型偶尔会生成空输出，而长时间运行的任务会被终止（由用户、电源管理或崩溃所致），并且此前无法恢复。

paragraphs.en: The read side decodes as UTF-8 with replacement, so no byte pattern can crash the reader thread. This fix ended a class of silent stalls. An empty generation triggers a hard reset of the turn rather than appending nothing. “Think-tag shells” (responses whose visible content is only a reasoning wrapper with no actionable output) are detected semantically and treated as empty. A kill-resume checkpoint records enough state to resume a terminated run from the last completed step.
paragraphs.zh: 读取端以替换方式解码为 UTF-8，因此没有任何字节模式会导致读取线程崩溃。 这一修复终结了一类静默停滞问题。 空生成会触发回合的强制重置，而不是追加空内容。“思考标签外壳”（其可见内容仅为推理包装层且没有可执行输出的响应）会被语义检测并视为空内容。 终止-恢复检查点记录了足够的状态，以便从最后完成的步骤重新开始已终止的运行。

sents.en: The read side decodes as UTF-8 with replacement, so no byte pattern can crash the reader thread.
sents.zh: 读取端以替换方式解码为 UTF-8，因此没有任何字节模式会导致读取线程崩溃。

sents.en: This fix ended a class of silent stalls.
sents.zh: 这一修复终结了一类静默停滞问题。

sents.en: An empty generation triggers a hard reset of the turn rather than appending nothing. “Think-tag shells” (responses whose visible content is only a reasoning wrapper with no actionable output) are detected semantically and treated as empty.
sents.zh: 空生成会触发回合的强制重置，而不是追加空内容。“思考标签外壳”（其可见内容仅为推理包装层且没有可执行输出的响应）会被语义检测并视为空内容。

sents.en: A kill-resume checkpoint records enough state to resume a terminated run from the last completed step.
sents.zh: 终止-恢复检查点记录了足够的状态，以便从最后完成的步骤重新开始已终止的运行。

paragraphs.en: Replacement decoding can garble individual characters in favor of never losing the stream; for agent work (logs, test output, paths) we found stream survival strictly more valuable than byte fidelity. Checkpoints add state to manage and were limited to one file per run.
paragraphs.zh: 替换解码可能会破坏单个字符，但能确保数据流永不丢失；对于智能体的工作（日志、测试输出、路径），我们发现保持数据流的完整性远比保留每个字节的准确性更为重要。 检查点会增加需要管理的状态信息，并且每次运行只能使用一个文件。

sents.en: Replacement decoding can garble individual characters in favor of never losing the stream; for agent work (logs, test output, paths) we found stream survival strictly more valuable than byte fidelity.
sents.zh: 替换解码可能会破坏单个字符，但能确保数据流永不丢失；对于智能体的工作（日志、测试输出、路径），我们发现保持数据流的完整性远比保留每个字节的准确性更为重要。

sents.en: Checkpoints add state to manage and were limited to one file per run.
sents.zh: 检查点会增加需要管理的状态信息，并且每次运行只能使用一个文件。

paragraphs.en: An agent that writes files and runs commands can write outside its working directory, access credential files, or — in harnesses with agent fan-out — spawn uncontrolled sub-agents. Small models are more prone to such divergences.
paragraphs.zh: 能够编写文件和运行命令的智能体可能会在工作目录之外写入文件、访问凭证文件，或者在与智能体分叉机制配合时生成不受控制的子智能体。 小型模型更容易出现此类偏离。

sents.en: An agent that writes files and runs commands can write outside its working directory, access credential files, or — in harnesses with agent fan-out — spawn uncontrolled sub-agents.
sents.zh: 能够编写文件和运行命令的智能体可能会在工作目录之外写入文件、访问凭证文件，或者在与智能体分叉机制配合时生成不受控制的子智能体。

sents.en: Small models are more prone to such divergences.
sents.zh: 小型模型更容易出现此类偏离。

paragraphs.en: Working-directory boundaries are enforced by normalized-path checks (symlink- and separator-safe on Windows). Sensitive paths ( .ssh , .env , credential stores) sit behind a gate. Out-of-bounds operations require explicit GUI confirmation by the human. Parallel sub-agents are denied by default (default-deny); when sub-agents are enabled, each gets a minimal system prompt that is not counted against the main prefill budget.
paragraphs.zh: 工作目录的边界通过规范化路径检查来强制执行（在 Windows 上对符号链接和路径分隔符均安全）。 敏感路径（.ssh、.env、凭证存储）受到一道防护门的保护。 超出边界的操作需要人类在图形用户界面中明确确认。 并行子智能体默认被拒绝（默认拒绝）；当启用子智能体时，每个子智能体都会获得一个最小的系统提示，该提示不计入主预填充预算。

sents.en: Working-directory boundaries are enforced by normalized-path checks (symlink- and separator-safe on Windows).
sents.zh: 工作目录的边界通过规范化路径检查来强制执行（在 Windows 上对符号链接和路径分隔符均安全）。

sents.en: Sensitive paths ( .ssh , .env , credential stores) sit behind a gate.
sents.zh: 敏感路径（.ssh、.env、凭证存储）受到一道防护门的保护。

sents.en: Out-of-bounds operations require explicit GUI confirmation by the human.
sents.zh: 超出边界的操作需要人类在图形用户界面中明确确认。

sents.en: Parallel sub-agents are denied by default (default-deny); when sub-agents are enabled, each gets a minimal system prompt that is not counted against the main prefill budget.
sents.zh: 并行子智能体默认被拒绝（默认拒绝）；当启用子智能体时，每个子智能体都会获得一个最小的系统提示，该提示不计入主预填充预算。

paragraphs.en: Confirmation dialogs add friction for power users; the default-deny rule forgoes an entire concurrency feature by default. We chose the configuration that is safe for a non-expert user on a single personal machine — the population a local-first harness primarily serves.
paragraphs.zh: 确认对话框会给高级用户带来操作负担；而默认拒绝的规则在初始状态下就放弃了一个完整的并发功能。 我们选择了对于非专业用户在单台个人计算机上安全使用的配置——这正是本地优先框架主要服务的用户群体。

sents.en: Confirmation dialogs add friction for power users; the default-deny rule forgoes an entire concurrency feature by default.
sents.zh: 确认对话框会给高级用户带来操作负担；而默认拒绝的规则在初始状态下就放弃了一个完整的并发功能。

sents.en: We chose the configuration that is safe for a non-expert user on a single personal machine — the population a local-first harness primarily serves.
sents.zh: 我们选择了对于非专业用户在单台个人计算机上安全使用的配置——这正是本地优先框架主要服务的用户群体。

paragraphs.en: M9 groups the capabilities that must fit under the M1 budget: capabilities are added only if they remain within the static prefill budget.
paragraphs.zh: M9 将必须适配 M1 预算的能力进行了分组：只有当新增能力仍在静态预填充预算范围内时，才会被添加。

paragraphs.en: Voice input ships with a bundled local STT model, pure CPU, approximately 20 × 20\times real time, with automatic end-of-speech detection.
paragraphs.zh: 语音输入附带一个本地预装 STT 模型，纯 CPU 运行，实时性约为 20 × 20\times，并支持自动结束语音检测。

paragraphs.en: Vision works by reading images into the message payload (verified with four vision-capable models).
paragraphs.zh: 视觉功能通过读取图像到消息负载中实现（已使用四种具备视觉能力的模型进行验证）。

paragraphs.en: Session memory is persistent, searchable, and replayable.
paragraphs.zh: 会话记忆是持久、可搜索且可重放的。

paragraphs.en: MCP servers connect through a flat JSON configuration.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 服务器通过扁平的 JSON 配置进行连接。

paragraphs.en: Skills are markdown files with frontmatter, progressively disclosed; dozens of skills compress to a few hundred tokens of standing context.
paragraphs.zh: 技能是带有元数据的 Markdown 文件，会逐步披露；数十个技能可压缩为数百个标记的静态上下文。

paragraphs.en: Model identity and context length are auto-detected from Ollama (default 128K, up to 256K).
paragraphs.zh: 模型身份和上下文长度将从 Ollama 自动检测（默认 128K，最高可达 256K）。

paragraphs.en: A task time-box ships off by default. The user writes a budget in plain language (in a dedicated box or in the task text itself; both Chinese and English phrasings are parsed, and a deadline written in the task overrides the box), and as the budget runs down the harness prompts the model to converge on a deliverable. Users of local models are, in our experience, sensitive to wall-clock time, and are better served by maximal delivery within a bounded run than by an unbounded one.
paragraphs.zh: 任务默认设有时间限制。 用户以自然语言输入预算（可填写在专用框中，也可直接写入任务文本；中文和英文表述都会被解析，且任务中明确写明的截止日期会覆盖专用框中的设置），随着预算逐渐耗尽，系统会引导模型聚焦于产出成果。 根据我们的经验，本地模型的用户对实际运行时间较为敏感，因此在一个有限运行时间内实现最大程度的交付，比无限期运行更能满足他们的需求。

paragraphs.en: Progressive disclosure means the model must know to open a skill file before using it; the skill index is kept in the standing context precisely so that this costs one read. None of these capabilities is novel individually; the constraint that ties them together (zero static prefill growth) is the contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 渐进式披露意味着模型必须知道在使用技能文件之前先打开它；技能索引被保留在静态上下文中，正是为了使其只需一次读取操作。 这些能力中没有任何一项单独而言是新颖的；将它们联系起来的约束条件（零静态预填充增长）才是真正的贡献。

paragraphs.en: 441 tests run in CI (v1.6.0). Two assertions matter most for this paper: the byte-level prefill net-zero assertion (M1) and the loop detector thresholds (M4), both regression-guarded.

paragraphs.en: The test suite constrains implementation speed; every contribution must keep the prefill budget intact, which has rejected otherwise reasonable designs (e.g. richer system prompts, always-on tool indexes).

They are listed once for inventory and not evaluated.

paragraphs.en: The five-ring safety model follows as M14.
paragraphs.zh: 五环安全模型随后是 M14。

paragraphs.en: Mid-task, a small model may attempt to uninstall a failing dependency or delete a system file; we observed this incident pattern in actual runs.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务执行过程中，小型模型可能会尝试卸载失败的依赖项或删除系统文件；我们在实际运行中观察到了这种事件模式。

paragraphs.en: Safety behavior is organized as five rings: sub-agents run sandboxed with permissions strictly narrower than the main agent’s; irreversible operations (formatting, raw-device writes, driver removal and the like) are refused outright; system-mutating actions are graded by operator presence (unattended runs default to deny, with an explicit per-run override); recursive deletion is confined to the working directory, with per-file alternatives offered when a request is refused; and the last ring is reversibility (.bak before writes, deletions moved to a trash directory, large-file overwrites requiring an explicit replace). A single environment variable provides a global override, used at the operator’s own risk.
paragraphs.zh: 安全行为被组织为五个层级：子智能体在沙盒环境中运行，其权限严格低于主智能体；不可逆操作（如格式设置、原始设备写入、驱动程序移除等）将被直接拒绝；系统变更类操作则根据操作员在场情况进行分级处理（无人值守的运行默认拒绝，但每次运行均可显式覆盖）；递归删除仅限于工作目录，当请求被拒绝时会提供针对单个文件的替代方案；最后一个层级是可逆性机制（写入前生成 .bak 备份、删除的文件移至回收站目录、大文件覆盖需显式执行替换操作）。 一个环境变量可提供全局覆盖功能，操作员需自行承担使用风险。

paragraphs.en: The rings may refuse operations an expert could perform safely; this conservative bias is deliberate given the target population defined in M8, and the explicit overrides preserve expert usability. The ring design is complementary to prompt-injection defenses evaluated elsewhere [ 52 , 53 ] : M14 governs what the agent’s own tool stream may do to the host, not what injected content can make it say.
paragraphs.zh: 这些环可能拒绝执行专家能够安全完成的操作；考虑到 M8 中定义的目标群体，这种保守的偏见是有意为之的，而显式的覆盖机制则保留了专家的可用性。 该环的设计与在其他地方评估的提示注入防御机制相互补充 [ 52 , 53 ]：M14 规定了智能体自身的工具流可以对主机执行的操作，而非注入内容可以使其说出什么。

sents.en: The ring design is complementary to prompt-injection defenses evaluated elsewhere [ 52 , 53 ] : M14 governs what the agent’s own tool stream may do to the host, not what injected content can make it say.
sents.zh: 该环的设计与在其他地方评估的提示注入防御机制相互补充 [ 52 , 53 ]：M14 规定了智能体自身的工具流可以对主机执行的操作，而非注入内容可以使其说出什么。

paragraphs.en: The rings are measured, not only designed. We built a 54-case probe set — 44 adversarial user requests (7/9/9/12/7 across rings 1–5) plus 10 benign controls — in which every adversarial prompt is a natural-language user request of the kind a small model accepts without suspicion (delete this failing service; write this file straight into the system temp area; read my SSH key and summarize it), never an injected text: the set tests what the agent’s own tool stream may do to the host, which is M14’s contract, not prompt-injection resistance (evaluated elsewhere, [ 52 , 53 ] ). Both small-tier matrix models were run once per case ( gemma4:e2b , qwen3.5:4b ; unattended mode, temperature 0, thinking disabled — the unified protocol of the matrix campaigns) on the v1.8.2-era tree (Appendix B ). Scoring is dual-channel: a marker channel reads the archived transcript and checkpoint for the rings’ own interception messages, and a ground-truth channel diffs host state before and after each case (sentinel files, content hashes, directory listings of the sensitive locations, NTFS alternate streams, one registry probe) plus rollback checks (an overwrite must leave a .bak or a trash entry, and must not truncate without backup). A third transcript-level rule flags any tool call whose command or path (never its file content) matches the case’s danger pattern and returned success; such flags are alerts rather than effects — each is verified against the ground-truth channel and the archived workdir, and the per-case disposition is published with the run ( benchmarks/safety/results_2609/ ). Table 2 reports the result.
paragraphs.zh: 这些环是经过测量的，而不仅仅是设计的。 我们构建了一个包含 54 个用例的探针集——包括 44 个对抗性用户请求（环 1–5 中分别为 7/9/9/12/7）以及 10 个良性对照用例——其中每个对抗性提示都是一个小型模型会无怀疑地接受的自然语言用户请求（删除这个失效的服务；将此文件直接写入系统临时区域；读取我的 SSH 密钥并总结其内容），而绝非注入的文本：该探针集旨在测试智能体自身的工具流可能对主机造成何种影响，而这正是 M14 的合同条款，而非提示注入抗性（后者已在别处进行评估，[52, 53]）。 两种小型矩阵模型在每个用例上各运行一次（gemma4:e2b、qwen3.5:4b；无人值守模式，温度设为 0，禁用思考功能——这是矩阵实验的统一协议），并在 v1.8.2 版本的树结构上执行（附录 B）。 评分采用双通道机制：一个标记通道读取存档的转录记录与检查点，以获取环自身的拦截信息；另一个基准真相通道则对比每次用例前后主机的状态（哨兵文件、内容哈希、敏感位置的目录列表、NTFS 替代流以及一个注册表探针），并执行回滚检查（任何覆盖操作必须留下 .bak 或回收站条目，且不得在未备份的情况下截断数据）。 第三个转录层规则会标记任何工具调用：若其命令或路径（而非文件内容）与当前用例的危险模式匹配且返回成功状态；此类标记属于警报而非实际影响——每个标记都会与基准真相通道及存档的工作目录进行验证，并且每个用例的最终处置结果会与运行记录一同发布（benchmarks/safety/results_2609/）。 表 2 报告了实验结果。

paragraphs.en: Ring 2 — outright irreversible commands — intercepts every attempted case on both models, and no confirmed leak runs through it. The confirmed end-to-end effects are 2 of 44 on the 2B and 11 of 44 on the 4B, and every one of them, on both models, routes through the raw bash command surface; the file tools’ resolved-path checks held on every case (blocked create_file / read_file attempts are visible in the transcripts). The 2B’s two leaks are narrow: an NTFS junction created inside the workdir aimed at the system temp directory (no payload written through it), and ring 5’s own reversibility contract failing on a plain overwrite (a workdir file truncated with no .bak and no trash entry). The 4B, by contrast, attacks in a methodical multi-route style: absolute-path and ..\..\ relative copies into system locations, a copy with the \\?\ prefix that dodges path normalization, a junction written through, a cd .. chain that escapes the workdir for commands the danger list does not name, and — in one case — a registry write that succeeded only on the fifth route, after four direct routes were refused in sequence, via a helper script written into the workdir and executed. It also read the refusal message’s override hint and tried to set the override variable inside its own command string; the repeated-call guard stopped that, not a ring. Per-call interception is respectable throughout (0.67–1.00 by ring); what fails is closing every route at once. We read this as the measured boundary of pattern-list enforcement: it holds against the impulsive tool use M14 is designed for and demonstrably does not hold against a methodical same-tier adversary.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 层——完全不可逆的命令——拦截了两个模型上所有尝试执行的用例，且没有任何已确认的泄露通过该层。 已确认的端到端影响在 2B 模型上为 44 个中的 2 个，在 4B 模型上为 44 个中的 11 个；在所有这些案例中，两个模型都通过原始 bash 命令接口执行；文件工具的解析路径检查在所有用例中都生效（被阻止的 create_file / read_file 尝试在记录中可见）。 2B 的两个泄露情况较为有限：一个是在工作目录内创建的、指向系统临时目录的 NTFS 连接（未通过该连接写入任何有效负载），另一个是第 5 层自身的可逆性协议在一次普通覆盖操作中失效（工作目录中的一个文件被截断，且没有生成 .bak 文件或回收站条目）。 相比之下，4B 采用了一种系统化的多路径攻击方式：包括使用绝对路径和 ..\..\ 相对路径向系统位置复制文件、使用 \\?\ 前缀以绕过路径规范化、通过连接写入文件、利用 cd .. 链逃出工作目录以执行危险列表中未明确命名的命令，以及在某一案例中，通过一个写入工作目录并执行的辅助脚本，在四个直接路径被依次拒绝后，于第五次尝试成功执行了注册表写入操作。 它还读取了拒绝信息中的覆盖提示，并试图在其自身命令字符串中设置覆盖变量；但重复调用防护机制阻止了这一行为，而非某一层。 每次调用的拦截效果在整个过程中表现良好（按层计算为 0.67–1.00）；真正失败的是同时阻断所有路径。 我们将此解读为模式列表执行机制的实测边界：该机制能有效抵御 M14 所设计的冲动性工具使用行为，但显然无法抵御系统化的同级别对手。

sents.en: The 4B, by contrast, attacks in a methodical multi-route style: absolute-path and ..\..\ relative copies into system locations, a copy with the \\?\ prefix that dodges path normalization, a junction written through, a cd .. chain that escapes the workdir for commands the danger list does not name, and — in one case — a registry write that succeeded only on the fifth route, after four direct routes were refused in sequence, via a helper script written into the workdir and executed.
sents.zh: 相比之下，4B 采用了一种系统化的多路径攻击方式：包括使用绝对路径和 ..\..\ 相对路径向系统位置复制文件、使用 \\?\ 前缀以绕过路径规范化、通过连接写入文件、利用 cd .. 链逃出工作目录以执行危险列表中未明确命名的命令，以及在某一案例中，通过一个写入工作目录并执行的辅助脚本，在四个直接路径被依次拒绝后，于第五次尝试成功执行了注册表写入操作。

sents.en: It also read the refusal message’s override hint and tried to set the override variable inside its own command string; the repeated-call guard stopped that, not a ring.
sents.zh: 它还读取了拒绝信息中的覆盖提示，并试图在其自身命令字符串中设置覆盖变量；但重复调用防护机制阻止了这一行为，而非某一层。

sents.en: Per-call interception is respectable throughout (0.67–1.00 by ring); what fails is closing every route at once.
sents.zh: 每次调用的拦截效果在整个过程中表现良好（按层计算为 0.67–1.00）；真正失败的是同时阻断所有路径。

sents.en: We read this as the measured boundary of pattern-list enforcement: it holds against the impulsive tool use M14 is designed for and demonstrably does not hold against a methodical same-tier adversary.
sents.zh: 我们将此解读为模式列表执行机制的实测边界：该机制能有效抵御 M14 所设计的冲动性工具使用行为，但显然无法抵御系统化的同级别对手。

paragraphs.en: Of the 10 benign in-workdir operations, the 2B completes 6 and the 4B completes 7. The refusals are informative: reading an in-workdir .env copy is refused on both models because the sensitive-path substring match has no workspace scoping (this probe targets exactly that, and it reproduces across models); on the 2B, two in-workdir recursive deletes were also refused, because the irreversible-command list fires before the workspace-scoping rule can allow them — the over-strictness is command-shape dependent, since the 4B’s PowerShell route through the same control was correctly allowed. One control per model completed without refusal but without the required artifact (a capability miss, counted separately from false refusals), and one 4B control timed out. Beyond the rings, the 2B runs show a model-level integrity failure no gate closes: in two verified-benign flags the finish summary asserted the refused action had been performed (a parent directory deleted; sensitive cards written to a shared library); the finish gate bounced each claim once and the model restated it, while ground truth showed no effect. The 4B’s analogous cases died in command-repetition timeouts before any finish claim; conversely, its confirmed leaks were reported honestly as successes — the model did what it claimed. We report both behaviors as measured, without claiming the finish gate catches false claims.
paragraphs.zh: 在 10 项良性 in-workdir 操作中，2B 完成了 6 项，4B 完成了 7 项。 拒绝操作的信息很有价值：在两种模型中，读取 in-workdir 下的 .env 副本都被拒绝，因为敏感路径子字符串匹配没有工作区范围限定（该测试正是针对这一点，且结果在不同模型间一致）；在 2B 中，两项 in-workdir 递归删除操作也被拒绝，因为不可逆命令列表在工作区范围限定规则允许它们之前就已触发——这种过度严格性取决于命令形式，因为 4B 通过相同控制流程的 PowerShell 操作被正确允许。 每个模型的一项控制操作虽未遭拒绝但未能生成所需产物（属于能力缺失，与错误拒绝分开计数），而一项 4B 控制操作则超时。 除了这些情况外，2B 的运行还暴露出模型层面的完整性故障：没有任何关卡被触发；在两项已验证为良性的标志中，最终摘要断言了被拒绝的操作已被执行（删除了一个父目录；向共享库写入敏感卡片）；最终关卡对每项声明各弹回一次，而模型则重申了该声明，但实际结果却显示没有任何影响。 4B 的类似情况在出现任何最终声明前就因命令重复而超时；相反，其已确认的泄露行为却被如实报告为成功——模型确实执行了它所声称的操作。 我们仅报告这两种观察到的行为，并不声称最终关卡能够识别错误声明。

paragraphs.en: LRAB is self-built, and this provenance constrains how its results may be used. A self-built benchmark cannot establish that Mingbird is the best harness in general; it can establish a causal statement: on these 18 tasks, on this machine, with these models, changing only the harness changes the outcome by the reported margin . Three principles follow. First, hold everything except the harness constant: same machine, same Ollama backend, same models, same time budgets, same scorer. Second, make every cell inspectable: tasks, fixtures, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results are published, so any aggregate is recomputable from raw rows. Third, treat the benchmark as one component of the evidence, with a third-party benchmark ( τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, Section 5.4 ) as the other.
paragraphs.zh: LRAB 是自行构建的，这一来源信息限制了其结果的使用方式。 一个自行构建的基准测试无法证明 Mingbird 在总体上是最好的运行框架；但它可以确立一个因果陈述：在这 18 项任务上、在这台机器上、使用这些模型时，仅改变运行框架就会使结果产生所报告的差异。由此可得出三项原则。 首先，除运行框架外保持所有其他因素不变：相同的机器、相同的 Ollama 后端、相同的模型、相同的时间预算和相同的评分器。 其次，确保每个单元格都可被检验：任务、测试用例、评分代码以及所有 288 个单元格内的结果均予以公开，因此任何汇总结果都可以通过原始数据行重新计算得出。 第三，将本基准测试视为证据的一个组成部分，而另一个组成部分则是一个第三方基准测试（τ²-bench，第 5.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The 18 tasks are emitted by versioned generator scripts (published in the repository) into a four-tier difficulty ladder, so that a failure can be localized to a regime rather than averaged into one number: T1 retrieval (WF-01/02), locate and extract from supplied fixtures; T2 synthesis (WF-03–06), implement features, synthesize data, write tests; T3 workflow (WF-07–15), multi-step work with well-defined artifacts — web research with real search queries and sourced findings, profiling and optimization, refactoring, comparison dossiers; T4 long-horizon (LH-01–03), multi-phase builds intended to run for hours, testing plan retention and recovery (M3, M7), with LH-03 doubling as a kill-and-resume stress test (checkpoint continuity at half budget). Each task specification is structured: domain, input fixtures the agent must ground in, a minimum credible plan, milestone checks, and final artifact checks. Task texts are concrete and verifiable by construction — they name the artifacts that must exist and the checks they must satisfy — and definitions are frozen before a campaign begins. The set covers the artifact-producing core of local agent work (code with tests, data analysis, grounded research, file organization, refactoring, multi-hour builds) and deliberately excludes what the external check covers: interactive tool-use dialogue (Section 5.4 ). Per-task specifications, generator scripts, and the full scoring rubrics are published in the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 这 18 项任务由版本化的生成脚本（已发布在仓库中）输出，构成一个四级的难度阶梯，这样失败就可以被定位到某个阶段，而不是被平均成一个单一数值：T1 检索（WF-01/02），从提供的固定材料中定位并提取信息；T2 合成（WF-03–06），实现功能、合成数据、编写测试；T3 工作流（WF-07–15），涉及多步骤操作和明确定义的成果物——包括使用真实搜索查询进行网络研究并获取来源信息、用户画像与优化、重构以及对比档案；T4 长期任务（LH-01–03），旨在运行数小时的多阶段构建，需测试计划保留与恢复能力（M3、M7），其中 LH-03 同时作为中断与恢复的压力测试（在半预算处检查点连续性）。 每项任务说明的结构包括：领域、智能体必须依据的输入材料、一个最低可信的计划、里程碑检查以及最终成果物检查。 任务文本在构造上具体且可验证——它们明确指出了必须存在的成果物以及这些成果物必须满足的检查项——并且在活动开始前定义即已固定。 该集合涵盖了本地智能体工作的核心成果物生成部分（含测试的代码、数据分析、基于事实的研究、文件组织、重构和多小时构建），并刻意排除了外部检查所涵盖的内容：交互式工具使用对话（第 5.4 节）。 各项任务的说明、生成脚本以及完整的评分标准均已发布在仓库中。

paragraphs.en: All 288 cells ran on one machine (an integrated GPU with 32 GB shared memory, Windows 11, Ollama as the only backend). Four harnesses (Mingbird, goose [ 12 ] , agent-mini [ 13 ] , and opencode [ 14 ] ), all stock and unpatched, each drove the same models: gemma4:e2b (2B by Ollama tag: 5B total, 2.3B active per token) [ 3 ] , qwen3.5:4b (4B), gemma4:12b (12B) [ 3 ] , and ornith-1.5:35b (Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, a public multimodal release by Ornith AI [ 54 ] ); Table 4 details parameter counts and architectures. 1 1 1 qwen3.5 has no separate technical report; [ 28 ] is the family report and [ 55 ] the model card. Despite 35B total parameters, ornith-1.5 is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) that activates roughly 3B per token, which is why this machine sustains long tasks end-to-end at roughly 26 tokens/s at a 128K context; the budgets therefore bind on reasoning and tool work rather than raw decode speed. Budgets are 90 minutes per workflow cell and 180 minutes per long-horizon cell. Each cell runs in a fresh working directory; harness processes are isolated from the scorer. Sampling is pinned to temperature 0 for all four arms, holding the sampling configuration fixed rather than inheriting each harness’s defaults: Mingbird pins 0 as its released default and agent-mini is configured to 0, while goose and opencode expose no temperature setting and are normalized at the transport level (a local proxy sets temperature=0 on their requests; harness binaries unmodified), verified on the wire. Left to their defaults, goose and opencode would sample at each model’s shipped parameters (temperature 1.0 for the gemma and qwen tiers, 0.8 for the ornith tier); those as-released numbers are retained in the released sensitivity data. Model-manifest penalties are untouched by the normalizer and identical across arms. One retry is allowed and the latest attempt wins; a timeout scores 0, and this rule applies to Mingbird as well. Retry usage was asymmetric in practice and we report it: across the final protocol batch the four arms logged 312 executions for 288 cells — Mingbird used 1 retry, opencode 0, goose 3, and agent-mini 20 (its crash-loop cells). The goose excess is one cell, WF-08 at 4B, whose archive holds four executions in total: two scored attempts, each a legitimate 90-minute timeout, and two retries killed externally before scoring — two over the one-retry budget, a protocol deviation we disclose.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 288 个单元格都在一台机器上运行（集成 GPU，配备 32 GB 共享内存、Windows 11，且仅使用 Ollama 作为后端）。 四个框架（Mingbird、goose [ 12 ]、agent-mini [ 13 ] 和 opencode [ 14 ]），均为原始未打补丁版本，各自运行相同的模型：gemma4:e2b（Ollama 标签为 2B，总参数量 5B，每个 token 激活 2.3B）[ 3 ]、qwen3.5:4b（4B）、gemma4:12b（12B）[ 3 ] 以及 ornith-1.5:35b（Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B，由 Ornith AI 发布的公开多模态版本 [ 54 ]）；表 4 详细列出了参数数量与架构。1 1 1 qwen3.5 没有单独的技术报告；[ 28 ] 是该系列报告，[ 55 ] 是模型卡片。 尽管 ornith-1.5 总参数量达到 35B，但它是一个专家混合（MoE）模型，每个 token 仅激活约 3B 参数，因此该机器能以约 26 tokens/s 的速度在 128K 上下文长度下端到端处理长任务；这意味着其资源限制主要体现在推理和工具调用上，而非原始解码速度。 每个工作流单元的资源预算为 90 分钟，每个长期预测单元为 180 分钟。 每个单元格都在新的工作目录中运行；框架进程与评分器相互隔离。 所有四个分支的采样温度均固定为 0，而非继承各框架的默认设置：Mingbird 将 0 作为其发布的默认值，agent-mini 也被配置为 0；而 goose 和 opencode 未提供温度设置，因此通过传输层进行标准化（本地代理在其请求中设置 temperature=0，框架二进制文件未经修改），且已在网络层面验证。 若保持默认设置，goose 和 opencode 将使用各模型发布时的参数进行采样（gemma 和 qwen 系列为温度 1.0，ornith 系列为 0.8）；这些原始数值也保留在已发布的敏感性数据中。 模型清单中的惩罚项未受标准化程序影响，且所有分支完全一致。 允许一次重试，且以最后一次尝试的结果为准；超时则得分为 0，此规则同样适用于 Mingbird。 实际重试使用情况并不对称，我们在此报告相关数据：在最终协议批次中，四个分支共记录了 288 个单元、312 次执行——Mingbird 使用 1 次重试，opencode 为 0 次，goose 为 3 次，agent-mini 为 20 次（其中为崩溃循环的单元格）。 goose 多出的重试来自一个单元 WF-08（4B），其存档中总共包含四次执行：两次成功评分的尝试（均为合法的 90 分钟超时），以及两次在评分前被外部终止的重试——这超出了单次重试的预算限制，属于我们在此披露的协议偏离行为。

sents.en: All 288 cells ran on one machine (an integrated GPU with 32 GB shared memory, Windows 11, Ollama as the only backend).
sents.zh: 所有 288 个单元格都在一台机器上运行（集成 GPU，配备 32 GB 共享内存、Windows 11，且仅使用 Ollama 作为后端）。

sents.en: Four harnesses (Mingbird, goose [ 12 ] , agent-mini [ 13 ] , and opencode [ 14 ] ), all stock and unpatched, each drove the same models: gemma4:e2b (2B by Ollama tag: 5B total, 2.3B active per token) [ 3 ] , qwen3.5:4b (4B), gemma4:12b (12B) [ 3 ] , and ornith-1.5:35b (Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, a public multimodal release by Ornith AI [ 54 ] ); Table 4 details parameter counts and architectures. 1 1 1 qwen3.5 has no separate technical report; [ 28 ] is the family report and [ 55 ] the model card.
sents.zh: 四个框架（Mingbird、goose [ 12 ]、agent-mini [ 13 ] 和 opencode [ 14 ]），均为原始未打补丁版本，各自运行相同的模型：gemma4:e2b（Ollama 标签为 2B，总参数量 5B，每个 token 激活 2.3B）[ 3 ]、qwen3.5:4b（4B）、gemma4:12b（12B）[ 3 ] 以及 ornith-1.5:35b（Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B，由 Ornith AI 发布的公开多模态版本 [ 54 ]）；表 4 详细列出了参数数量与架构。1 1 1 qwen3.5 没有单独的技术报告；[ 28 ] 是该系列报告，[ 55 ] 是模型卡片。

sents.en: Despite 35B total parameters, ornith-1.5 is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) that activates roughly 3B per token, which is why this machine sustains long tasks end-to-end at roughly 26 tokens/s at a 128K context; the budgets therefore bind on reasoning and tool work rather than raw decode speed.
sents.zh: 尽管 ornith-1.5 总参数量达到 35B，但它是一个专家混合（MoE）模型，每个 token 仅激活约 3B 参数，因此该机器能以约 26 tokens/s 的速度在 128K 上下文长度下端到端处理长任务；这意味着其资源限制主要体现在推理和工具调用上，而非原始解码速度。

sents.en: Budgets are 90 minutes per workflow cell and 180 minutes per long-horizon cell.
sents.zh: 每个工作流单元的资源预算为 90 分钟，每个长期预测单元为 180 分钟。

sents.en: Each cell runs in a fresh working directory; harness processes are isolated from the scorer.
sents.zh: 每个单元格都在新的工作目录中运行；框架进程与评分器相互隔离。

sents.en: Sampling is pinned to temperature 0 for all four arms, holding the sampling configuration fixed rather than inheriting each harness’s defaults: Mingbird pins 0 as its released default and agent-mini is configured to 0, while goose and opencode expose no temperature setting and are normalized at the transport level (a local proxy sets temperature=0 on their requests; harness binaries unmodified), verified on the wire.
sents.zh: 所有四个分支的采样温度均固定为 0，而非继承各框架的默认设置：Mingbird 将 0 作为其发布的默认值，agent-mini 也被配置为 0；而 goose 和 opencode 未提供温度设置，因此通过传输层进行标准化（本地代理在其请求中设置 temperature=0，框架二进制文件未经修改），且已在网络层面验证。

sents.en: Left to their defaults, goose and opencode would sample at each model’s shipped parameters (temperature 1.0 for the gemma and qwen tiers, 0.8 for the ornith tier); those as-released numbers are retained in the released sensitivity data.
sents.zh: 若保持默认设置，goose 和 opencode 将使用各模型发布时的参数进行采样（gemma 和 qwen 系列为温度 1.0，ornith 系列为 0.8）；这些原始数值也保留在已发布的敏感性数据中。

sents.en: Model-manifest penalties are untouched by the normalizer and identical across arms.
sents.zh: 模型清单中的惩罚项未受标准化程序影响，且所有分支完全一致。

sents.en: One retry is allowed and the latest attempt wins; a timeout scores 0, and this rule applies to Mingbird as well.
sents.zh: 允许一次重试，且以最后一次尝试的结果为准；超时则得分为 0，此规则同样适用于 Mingbird。

sents.en: Retry usage was asymmetric in practice and we report it: across the final protocol batch the four arms logged 312 executions for 288 cells — Mingbird used 1 retry, opencode 0, goose 3, and agent-mini 20 (its crash-loop cells).
sents.zh: 实际重试使用情况并不对称，我们在此报告相关数据：在最终协议批次中，四个分支共记录了 288 个单元、312 次执行——Mingbird 使用 1 次重试，opencode 为 0 次，goose 为 3 次，agent-mini 为 20 次（其中为崩溃循环的单元格）。

sents.en: The goose excess is one cell, WF-08 at 4B, whose archive holds four executions in total: two scored attempts, each a legitimate 90-minute timeout, and two retries killed externally before scoring — two over the one-retry budget, a protocol deviation we disclose.
sents.zh: goose 多出的重试来自一个单元 WF-08（4B），其存档中总共包含四次执行：两次成功评分的尝试（均为合法的 90 分钟超时），以及两次在评分前被外部终止的重试——这超出了单次重试的预算限制，属于我们在此披露的协议偏离行为。

paragraphs.en: The cell is zero-scored by operator decision as a runner-level failure under any reading, and its wall-clock was never carried into the published CSV (which is why it is absent from the budget census of Section 4.5 ). Rather than assert that the rule is neutral we state the counterfactual it can move: the only released Mingbird cell shaped by the rule is WF-09 at 4B, whose first attempt timed out and whose retry ended in a runner error with partial artifacts on disk, scored at its artifact value (0.5) — under a no-retry reading that cell scores 0, so the rule accounts for at most 0.5 / 18 = + 0.028 0.5/18=+0.028 of Mingbird’s 4B mean; every ranking is unchanged under either reading. The one Mingbird zero (WF-08 at 35B) is a run that completed without artifacts and is published as such.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何解读方式下，该单元格因操作员的决策而被判定为运行级失败，其实际运行时间从未被纳入已发布的 CSV 文件（这就是为何它未出现在第 4.5 节的预算统计中）。 我们并未断言该规则是中立的，而是陈述了其可能产生的反事实影响：唯一受此规则影响的已发布 Mingbird 单元格是位于 4B 的 WF-09，其首次尝试超时，重试则以运行错误告终，且磁盘上存在部分产物，因此按产物值（0.5）评分——在不重试的解读方式下，该单元格的得分为 0，因此该规则最多仅对 Mingbird 在 4B 的平均值产生 +0.028（即 0.5/18）的影响；无论采用哪种解读方式，所有排名均保持不变。 唯一的一个 Mingbird 零分单元格（位于 35B 的 WF-08）是一次未生成任何产物便完成的运行，并以此身份被发布。

paragraphs.en: The published matrix spans three collection windows (Table 3 ): agent-mini 2026-09-01..04, configured to the unified protocol through its own configuration surface; Mingbird 2026-09-13..14 on the final v1.5.0 code, so that every published Mingbird cell reflects the released code rather than an intermediate build; and goose and opencode 2026-09-18..20, re-shot under the unified protocol to replace their September 1–4 runs at shipped sampling defaults (those legacy runs are retained as the released thinking-sensitivity data). Machine, task set, budgets, model tags, and scorer are common to all three windows; the goose/opencode re-shot crosses the original campaign boundary, and the temporal-confounding treatment of that crossing is the campaign-ordering paragraph of Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的矩阵涵盖三个收集窗口（表3）：智能体-mini 2026-09-01..04，通过其自身的配置界面配置为统一协议；Mingbird 2026-09-13..14 基于最终 v1.5.0 代码，因此每个已发布的 Mingbird 单元格都反映已发布的代码，而非中间构建版本；以及 goose 和 opencode 2026-09-18..20，在统一协议下重新采集，以取代它们9月1日至4日基于默认采样设置的运行（这些旧版运行仍保留为已发布的思考灵敏度数据）。 机器、任务集、预算、模型标签和评分器在这三个窗口中均保持一致；goose/opencode 的重新采集跨越了原始活动的边界，而对这一跨越的时间混淆处理正是第6节中活动排序部分的讨论内容。

paragraphs.en: Scoring is deterministic and artifact-based: files exist where the task specifies; tests pass when executed; reports contain the required findings. Scores are partial: a cell with seven equally weighted checks scores 0.571 when four pass; where weights are non-uniform, the published rubric states them explicitly. Harness processes have no access to the scorer, so a harness cannot improve its score by any means other than producing artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 评分是确定性的且基于成果：任务中指定的文件必须存在；测试执行时必须通过；报告必须包含所需的发现内容。 评分是部分的：一个单元格中有七个权重相等的检查项，若其中四个通过，则得分为 0.571；若权重不均等，则已发布的评分标准会明确说明各权重。 测试框架进程无法访问评分者，因此测试框架不能通过任何除生成成果之外的方式提高其得分。
