paragraphs.en: Harnesses differ substantially in wall-clock behavior, and a benchmark must fix how to price that. LRAB prices time with uniform budgets per task family and does not normalize raw seconds. The rationale is that an agent is useful to a user only if it delivers within the time that the user is willing to wait; wall-clock differences between harnesses therefore reflect real architectural costs. In goose’s case, a large prefill amplified by long contexts manifests as slower but substantive work: its slowest cell runs 11.7 × \times slower than Mingbird on the same task and model (WF-04, 12B; derived from the published CSV). Discounting seconds would have rewarded harnesses that terminate early over harnesses that work slowly, and awarding speed-normalized credit would have rewarded doing less per turn. Budget pricing instead encodes the user-facing requirement: finish within the budget or score zero. In the released matrix no arm actually hit the ceiling: the number of cells, of each arm’s 72, whose wall time reached 95% or more of the budget is zero for all four arms (Mingbird, goose, opencode, agent-mini: 0/72 each; the one budget-terminated cell in the matrix — goose’s WF-08 at 4B — has no wall-clock recorded in the published CSV, so it enters this census through no arm; Section 4.3 ), so in this batch budget pricing changed no cell’s score through timeout truncation. We report the wall-clock consequences explicitly in Section 5.3 , so that readers who prefer a different pricing can re-derive it from the CSV.
paragraphs.zh: 不同执行框架的实际运行时间行为存在显著差异，基准测试必须明确如何对这种差异进行定价。 LRAB 按任务类别分配统一的预算来为时间定价，且不对原始秒数进行归一化处理。 其逻辑在于：只有当智能体能在用户愿意等待的时间内完成任务时，它才对用户有用；因此，不同执行框架之间的实际运行时间差异反映了真实的架构成本。 在 goose 的案例中，由长上下文放大的大规模预填充表现为速度更慢但工作量更实质性的操作：其最慢的单元在执行相同任务和模型（WF-04、12B；数据源自已发布的 CSV）时，比 Mingbird 慢了 11.7 倍。 对秒数进行折扣处理将奖励那些提前终止的执行框架，而非运行缓慢的执行框架；而采用速度归一化的信用评分则会奖励每轮执行更少操作的情况。 预算定价方式则直接体现了面向用户的要求：必须在预算内完成，否则得分为零。 在已发布的矩阵中，没有任何一个分支实际触达上限：在所有四个分支（Mingbird、goose、opencode、agent-mini）的 72 个单元中，实际运行时间达到预算 95% 或以上的单元数量均为零（各为 0/72；矩阵中唯一因预算耗尽而终止的单元——goose 在 WF-08 上于 4B 时的表现——在已发布的 CSV 中未记录实际运行时间，因此该单元未计入此统计；参见第 4.3 节）。因此，在这一批测试中，预算定价并未因超时截断而改变任何单元得分。 我们在第 5.3 节中明确报告了实际运行时间带来的影响，以便偏好不同定价方式的读者能够根据 CSV 数据重新计算结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 summarizes the main results. Mingbird averages 0.886 over its 72 cells, against 0.631 for goose, 0.479 for opencode, and 0.405 for agent-mini.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 总结了主要结果。 Mingbird 在其 72 个单元格上的平均值为 0.886，而 goose 为 0.631，opencode 为 0.479，agent-mini 为 0.405。

sents.en: Table 5 summarizes the main results.
sents.zh: 表 5 总结了主要结果。

sents.en: Mingbird averages 0.886 over its 72 cells, against 0.631 for goose, 0.479 for opencode, and 0.405 for agent-mini.
sents.zh: Mingbird 在其 72 个单元格上的平均值为 0.886，而 goose 为 0.631，opencode 为 0.479，agent-mini 为 0.405。

paragraphs.en: Because each cell is a single run, we treat the 18 tasks as the unit of analysis. Within each model size, Mingbird is compared with each competitor by a two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 18 task pairs, with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals over task resamples (10,000 resamples, fixed seed) and Holm correction across the three comparisons within a model; the script ( analyze_significance.py ) ships with the repository. At 2B and 12B, the Mingbird advantage over all three competitors is significant after Holm correction (largest adjusted p p per model: 0.0008 at 2B, 0.0466 at 12B). At 4B only the comparison with opencode is significant (adjusted p = 0.0181 p=0.0181 ); goose, with thinking disabled under the unified protocol, closes to 0.801 against Mingbird’s 0.876 and the comparison does not reach significance (raw p = 0.3258 p=0.3258 ), nor does agent-mini at its strongest tier (adjusted p = 0.1486 p=0.1486 ). At 35B the comparisons with goose (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0415 p=0.0415 ) and agent-mini ( 0.0005 0.0005 ) are significant, while opencode at 0.896 against Mingbird’s 0.941 does not separate (raw p = 0.4652 p=0.4652 ). We read this honestly: under the unified no-thinking protocol two competitors close the gap at their strongest tiers, and the robust Mingbird advantages are the small-model segment and the overall margin. Figure 5 shows the score distributions behind these tests.

paragraphs.en: The 18 tasks are generated in four families (2 retrieval, 4 synthesis, 9 workflow, 3 long-horizon), so task-level pairing overstates independence. We therefore re-ran the analysis with the family as the resampling unit (cluster bootstrap over the four families; script alongside analyze_significance.py ). Two properties of this analysis must be stated precisely, and they discipline what family-level claims are available at all. First, when all four family means are non-negative, a cluster-bootstrap CI cannot cross zero by construction — every resample of non-negative family means is non-negative — so such a CI is uninformative whatever its width; this applies to every comparison whose family means share a sign, including the ones that favor us (at 2B all three comparisons; at 4B vs. goose; at 12B vs. goose, whose tier-1 mean is exactly zero). Second, the auxiliary sign permutation flips task-level signs within families; it is a task-level test — a family-level flip would have only 2 4 = 16 2^{4}=16 sign patterns and a minimum two-sided p p of 0.125 0.125 — so with four families no family-level significance claim is available for any comparison, ours included. Under that standard the honest family-level statements are: at 2B the paired advantage is descriptively present in all four families (all four family means strictly positive: + 1.000 / + 0.428 / + 0.413 / + 0.823 +1.000/+0.428/+0.413/+0.823 vs. goose), which is the strongest family-level evidence four clusters can give, but it is not a family-clustered significance claim; the task-level tests remain significant as reported. The one comparison whose cluster CI is informative is 4B vs. agent-mini, the only one with a negative family mean (long-horizon − 0.221 -0.221 ): its cluster CI crosses zero, consistent with its already-nonsignificant adjusted p p . 4B vs. goose and 12B vs. goose fall in the uninformative category above; their task-level results stand as reported (nonsignificant p = 0.35 p=0.35 ; marginal adjusted p = 0.036 p=0.036 ). No comparison that was nonsignificant becomes significant under clustering.
paragraphs.zh: 这18项任务被划分为四个家族（2项检索、4项合成、9项工作流、3项长期任务），因此任务层面的配对分析夸大了其独立性。 因此，我们以家族为单位进行重采样（对四个家族执行聚类自助法；相关脚本见 analyze_significance.py），重新运行了分析。 必须明确说明该分析的两种特性，这些特性决定了哪些家族层面的结论是可行的。 首先，当所有四个家族的均值均为非负时，根据构造原则，聚类自助置信区间（CI）不可能跨越零——因为每次重采样得到的非负家族均值组合本身也是非负的——因此无论其宽度如何，这样的置信区间都缺乏信息价值；这一结论适用于所有家族均值符号相同的比较，包括那些对我们有利的情况（2B中全部三个比较；4B与goose的比较；12B与goose的比较，后者的第一层级均值恰好为零）。 其次，辅助的符号置换会翻转家族内部的任务层面符号；这是一种任务层面的检验——若为家族层面的翻转，则仅存在2⁴=16种符号模式，最小双侧p值为0.125——因此，在四个家族的情况下，任何比较（包括我们的比较）都无法得出家族层面的显著性结论。 按照这一标准，诚实的家族层面陈述如下：在2B中，配对优势在所有四个家族中均有描述性体现（所有四个家族的均值均为严格正值：+1.000/+0.428/+0.413/+0.823 vs. goose），这是四个聚类所能提供的最强家族层面证据，但这并非家族-聚类层面的显著性结论；任务层面的检验结果仍如报告所示具有显著性。 唯一一个聚类置信区间具有信息价值的比较是4B与agent-mini，这是唯一存在负值家族均值（长期任务：−0.221）的比较：其聚类置信区间跨越了零，这与它原本就不显著的调整后p值一致；4B与goose以及12B与goose的比较则属于上述缺乏信息价值的类别；它们的任务层面结果仍如报告所示有效（不显著，p=0.35；边际调整后p=0.036）。 没有任何原本不显著的比较在聚类分析后变得显著。

paragraphs.en: Tiers and families are confounded in Table 5 : one model per tier, so the 2B point is the gemma4:e2b MatFormer family as much as it is 2B. We therefore ran one additional model through the same 18-task protocol on the same code base (v1.5.0), the same budgets and the same deterministic scorer: qwen3.5:2b , a 2.3B dense model from the family already represented at 4B and 35B. Mingbird scores 0.779 on it — 0.852 over the 15 workflow tasks and 0.410 over the three long-horizon ones, 15 of 18 cells at or above half credit — against 0.821 on the published 2B point, a paired difference of − 0.042 -0.042 over the same 18 tasks. The small-tier result is therefore not a property of the MatFormer family; and within the Qwen family alone, the step from 2B to 4B is + 0.097 +0.097 . Two protocol notes apply to this row: the upstream tag ships Q8_0 weights rather than the Q4_K_M used for the four matrix models (a stronger quantization, so the comparison is if anything conservative), and it was run without the per-cell backend restart used elsewhere in the campaign (Section B ). The three baseline harnesses were then run on this model under the same protocol (sampling pinned to zero and thinking disabled at the transport layer, as in the published matrix): goose 0.096, opencode 0.017 and agent-mini 0.239 against Mingbird’s 0.779. The small-tier separation of Table 5 therefore reproduces in a second family — the Mingbird margin is 0.54 to 0.76 on this model against 0.55 to 0.80 on gemma4:e2b , at the same tier and over the same 18 tasks — so the cliff is a harness property rather than a property of one model family. All 72 cells of this second-family row are published ( benchmarks/family_qwen352b_2609.csv ).

paragraphs.en: On the three multi-hour tasks, Mingbird averages 0.827, ahead of agent-mini (0.484), goose (0.394), and opencode (0.354), all derived from the same 12 published cells per harness. The margin is widest exactly where turn counts stretch furthest; disabling goose’s thinking under the unified protocol drops its long-horizon mean from 0.623 to 0.394, its 35B long-horizon cells all falling. Mingbird’s weakest non-zero cells (0.403 and 0.429, LH-02 and LH-03 at 4B) are in this segment.
paragraphs.zh: 在三项持续数小时的任务中，Mingbird 的平均得分为 0.827，领先于 agent-mini（0.484）、goose（0.394）和 opencode（0.354），这些分数均基于每个测试框架中相同的 12 个已发布单元得出。 当回合数最多时，这种差距也最为显著；在统一协议下禁用 goose 的思考能力后，其长期任务的平均得分从 0.623 降至 0.394，其所有 35B 长期任务单元的成绩也随之下降。 Mingbird 最弱的非零单元（0.403 和 0.429，分别对应 4B 下的 LH-02 和 LH-03）就位于这一阶段。

paragraphs.en: The matrix compresses 288 runs; the transferable findings are the underlying failure forms. Figure 4 makes the failure structure visible at the task level. Our five-form taxonomy is single-agent and local-tier; it is complementary to the multi-agent failure taxonomy of MAST [ 56 ] , which classifies failures of multi-agent LLM systems from operator reports rather than measured cells.
paragraphs.zh: 该矩阵压缩了 288 次运行；可迁移的发现是潜在的故障形式。 图 4 在任务层面揭示了故障结构。 我们的五形式分类法是单智能体且本地层级的；它与 MAST [56] 的多智能体故障分类法互为补充，后者基于操作员报告而非测量单元来对多智能体 LLM 系统的故障进行分类。

paragraphs.en: Mingbird: one artifact-free run in the whole matrix. The single zero-scored cell (WF-08, 35B) ended after 276 seconds: the model wrote a task plan, then repeatedly declared completion without writing the deliverables; the finish gate rejected each declaration (the transcript is published), and the run ended with no artifacts on disk. If that cell were excluded rather than scored 0, the 35B mean would rise from 0.941 to 0.996; we report 0.941, as the protocol requires. One further cell (WF-09, 4B) ended in a runner error after producing partial artifacts and is scored at its artifact value (0.5); excluding it would raise the 4B mean from 0.876 to 0.898, and excluding both anomalous cells leaves every ranking unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: Mingbird：整个矩阵中仅有一次无产物运行。 唯一得零分的单元格（WF-08，35B）在 276 秒后结束：该模型写了一个任务计划，然后反复宣布完成，但未编写交付成果；结束门拒绝了每次宣布（转录已发布），且运行结束时磁盘上没有任何产物。 如果排除该单元格而非将其计为 0 分，35B 的平均值将从 0.941 升至 0.996；但根据协议要求，我们报告的是 0.941。 另一个单元格（WF-09，4B）在生成部分产物后因运行错误而结束，其得分按产物值计算（0.5）；若排除该单元格，4B 的平均值将从 0.876 升至 0.898，而排除这两个异常单元格后，所有排名均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: agent-mini at 35B: platform mismatch. 14 of its 18 cells at 35B scored zero, and the published wall-times show why: those runs all ended within 80 seconds. Inspection of the attempt directories shows the agent issuing Unix-flavored commands into a Windows shell, failing, and exiting. This is a harness–platform fit failure, not a model failure; the same model scores 0.679–0.941 on other harnesses. A sensitivity view over the whole matrix: agent-mini has 30 early-exit cells in total (wall time under 80 s: 15 at 35B, 13 at 2B, 2 at 4B, nearly all scoring zero). Excluding those 30 (task, model) combinations from all four arms (each arm keeps the same 42 cells) changes the overall means to Mingbird 0.901, goose 0.709, agent-mini 0.617, opencode 0.486: Mingbird remains first (margin over the runner-up narrows from + 0.255 +0.255 to + 0.193 +0.193 ), but agent-mini and opencode swap third and fourth place. Per tier, the 2B segment after this exclusion is Mingbird 0.843 vs. goose 0.200, agent-mini 0.414, opencode 0.000 over the remaining cells — removing platform-mismatch cells widens the small-model separation rather than narrowing it. The 80 s cutoff itself deserves scrutiny: opencode’s 2B failures end within 49–115 s (below), and raising the threshold to 120 s to cover that window excludes agent-mini’s entire 2B row (all 18 of its 2B cells end within 120 s), degenerating the analysis — the shared property of these cells is the early-exit failure form, not the exact cutoff. The overall ranking’s tail is therefore sensitive to the platform dimension; the headline claim (first place, and the 2B segment) is not.
paragraphs.zh: agent-mini 在 35B 上的表现：平台不匹配。其 18 个单元格中，有 14 个在 35B 上得分为零，已公布的运行时间也说明了原因：这些运行全部在 80 秒内结束。 对尝试目录的检查显示，该智能体向 Windows 命令行发出类 Unix 命令，但执行失败并退出。 这是测试环境与平台适配的失败，而非模型本身的失败；同一模型在其他测试环境中的得分为 0.679–0.941。 对整个矩阵进行敏感性分析：agent-mini 共有 30 个提前退出的单元格（运行时间低于 80 秒：35B 上 15 个，2B 上 13 个，4B 上 2 个，且几乎全部得分为零）。 若从所有四条分支中排除这 30 种（任务、模型）组合（每条分支仍保留相同的 42 个单元格），整体均值将变为 Mingbird 0.901、goose 0.709、agent-mini 0.617、opencode 0.486：Mingbird 仍居第一（与第二名之间的差距从 +0.255 缩小至 +0.193），但 agent-mini 和 opencode 的排名互换，分别位于第三和第四位。 按层级来看，排除上述组合后，2B 部分的得分情况为：Mingbird 0.843 vs. goose 0.200、agent-mini 0.414、opencode 0.000（基于剩余单元格计算）——移除平台不匹配单元格后，小模型之间的差距反而扩大，而非缩小。 80 秒的截止时间本身也值得审视：opencode 在 2B 上的失败运行时间在 49–115 秒之间（见下文），若将阈值提高到 120 秒以覆盖该区间，则 agent-mini 在 2B 上的整行数据都会被排除（其全部 18 个 2B 单元格都在 120 秒内结束），导致分析失效——这些单元格的共同特征是提前退出失败，而非具体的截止时间。 因此，整体排名的尾部对平台维度较为敏感，但主要结论（第一名以及 2B 部分的排名）并不受影响。

paragraphs.en: opencode: premature termination at the small end. Its 2B cells ended early (typically within 49–115 seconds) with the required artifacts never created — 17 of 18 score zero — a plausible explanation being an exit path that conflates unresolvable states with completion. Under the unified no-thinking protocol its larger tiers recover substantially (12B 0.140 → \to 0.539, 35B 0.776 → \to 0.896; thinking-on values are from the legacy pre-re-shot batch), which we return to in the thinking-sensitivity discussion.
paragraphs.zh: opencode：在较小端过早终止。 其 2B 智能体提前终止（通常在 49–115 秒内），且从未生成所需的产物——18 个中有 17 个得分为零——一个合理的解释是，其退出路径将无法解决的状态与完成状态混为一谈。 在统一的“无思考”协议下，其较大的层级恢复显著（12B 从 0.140 → \to 0.539，35B 从 0.776 → \to 0.896；“思考中”的数值来自旧版 pre-re-shot 批次），我们将在“思考敏感性”的讨论中再次提及这一点。

paragraphs.en: goose: slow but substantive progress. goose’s median and typical slow cells are the slowest of the four (Section 5.3 ), but its failures are qualitatively different: its runs make substantive progress under a large prefill amplified by long contexts, and it scores 0.679 at 35B (0.822 with thinking on, legacy batch). Its 2B collapse is consistent with the prefill-cost failure form that M1 addresses.
paragraphs.zh: goose：进展缓慢但实质性强。goose 的中位数和典型慢速单元是四种中最慢的（第 5.3 节），但其失败模式在性质上有所不同：其运行在长上下文放大的大量预填充下能取得实质性进展，并且在 35B 时得分为 0.679（开启思考模式并使用旧版批量处理时得分为 0.822）。 其 2B 的崩溃模式与 M1 所解决的预填充成本失败形式一致。

paragraphs.en: Mean wall-clock over all cells (71 values for goose, because one cell is missing wall-clock in the published CSV — the WF-08/qwen3.5:4b cell, a runner-level failure that scores 0 under the timeout/error rule (Section 4.3 ) whose wall-clock was not carried into the CSV; and 72 for the others, computed from the published CSV): Mingbird 585.5 s (median 440.5), goose 866.4 s (median 692.4), agent-mini 233.5 s (median 116.4), opencode 633.4 s (median 450.1). Restricted to the 15 workflow tasks the medians are 415.4 s (Mingbird), 707.9 s (goose), 133.8 s (agent-mini), and 479.4 s (opencode). Figure 6 places every cell with a recorded wall-clock time in the score–time plane. agent-mini is fast because it exits early; speed without artifacts is not credit, and the budget protocol already encodes that. goose is the slowest harness that produces substantive work (on individual cells it runs up to 11.7 × \times{} slower than Mingbird), which we attribute to prefill size times context length per turn, and which its 4B/12B scores show is not disqualifying at larger model scale. Mingbird’s own slow cells are WF-11 at 4B (3344 s) and its long-horizon runs, consistent with more turns spent on verification rather than fewer. Readers who would price time differently can recompute any weighting from the CSV; the protocol’s choice (budget pricing, no second discounting) is stated in Section 4.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有单元的实际运行时间均值（goose 为 71 个值，因为已发布的 CSV 中缺少一个单元的实际运行时间——即 WF-08/qwen3.5:4b 单元，这是一个运行级故障，根据超时/错误规则（第 4.3 节）得分为 0，其实际运行时间未被录入 CSV；其余单元为 72 个值，数据来自已发布的 CSV）：Mingbird 585.5 秒（中位数 440.5 秒），goose 866.4 秒（中位数 692.4 秒），agent-mini 233.5 秒（中位数 116.4 秒），opencode 633.4 秒（中位数 450.1 秒）。 仅针对 15 个工作流任务，中位数分别为 415.4 秒（Mingbird）、707.9 秒（goose）、133.8 秒（agent-mini）和 479.4 秒（opencode）。 图 6 将每个记录了实际运行时间的单元置于得分–时间平面上。agent-mini 之所以快，是因为它会提前退出；没有生成有效结果的快速表现并不值得称赞，预算协议已经体现了这一点。goose 是运行最慢但能产生实质性工作的框架（在单个单元上，其运行速度比 Mingbird 慢高达 11.7 倍），我们认为这与每次轮次的预填充大小乘以上下文长度有关，而其 4B/12B 的得分表明，在更大规模的模型中，这一因素并不会导致其被淘汰。 Mingbird 自身运行较慢的单元是 4B 下的 WF-11（3344 秒）及其长时程运行，这与它用于验证的轮次更多而非更少的情况一致。 对时间赋予不同权重的读者可以根据 CSV 重新计算任何加权方式；协议所采用的选择（预算定价，无二次折扣）已在第 4.5 节中说明。

paragraphs.en: Because LRAB is self-built, we additionally evaluated on a third-party benchmark: τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench [ 15 ] , in all three of its domains (retail, airline, and telecom). A simulated user converses with an agent that must operate domain tools under policy, and scoring verifies the final database state, so an agent that bypasses its tool stream and merely pretends to call tools fails the database check. The protocol is uniform across all arms and matches the LRAB matrix: the agent side is the same local qwen3.5:4b (Ollama) at temperature 0 with thinking disabled (pinned at the transport layer for the CLI arms, request-level for Mingbird; verified end-to-end: the identical request produces 586 characters of thinking when sent directly and none through the pinning proxy), the user simulator is the same cloud model ( qwen3.8-flash ) for every harness (not the official gpt-4o user configuration), and scoring is pass@1 with errored trials counted as 0. The benchmark’s natural-language assertions are graded by an LLM judge; we run the judge ( qwen3.8-max ) and the simulator through the same DashScope (Alibaba Cloud) endpoint in every arm, so both sides are held fixed across the comparison. opencode connects to the domain tools through MCP, its native tool mechanism; the benchmark’s native LLM agent — the upstream default LLM-agent implementation shipped with the τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench release pinned in Appendix B , with prompts and tool-calling protocol at upstream defaults, unmodified — and Mingbird drive the tools directly.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 LRAB 是自建的，我们还额外在第三方基准测试 τ 2 \tau^{2}-bench [15] 的三大领域（零售、航空和电信）中进行了评估。 模拟用户与智能体进行对话，该智能体必须在策略约束下操作领域工具，评分机制会验证最终的数据库状态；因此，任何绕过工具流、仅假装调用工具的智能体都会在数据库检查中失败。 该协议在所有分支中保持一致，并与 LRAB 矩阵相匹配：智能体端使用相同的本地 qwen3.5:4b（Ollama），温度为 0 且禁用思考功能（对于 CLI 分支，在传输层进行固定；对于 Mingbird，则在请求层面固定；经过端到端验证：相同请求直接发送时会产生 586 个字符的思考内容，而通过固定代理发送时则无任何思考内容）；用户模拟器在所有测试框架中均使用相同的云模型（qwen3.8-flash），而非官方的 gpt-4o 用户配置；评分标准为 pass@1，错误尝试计为 0。 该基准测试的自然语言断言由 LLM 裁判进行评分；我们在每个分支中都通过相同的 DashScope（阿里云）端点运行裁判（qwen3.8-max）和模拟器，从而确保比较过程中双方保持一致。opencode 通过 MCP（其原生工具机制）连接领域工具；而基准测试的原生 LLM 智能体——即 τ 2 \tau^{2}-bench 发布版本中随附的默认上游 LLM-agent 实现（提示词和工具调用协议均使用上游默认设置且未修改）以及 Mingbird，则直接驱动这些工具。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 gives the numbers. In retail (114 runnable tasks of the official 115-task suite), Mingbird scores 0.763 against 0.675 for the native agent and 0.588 for opencode. In airline (50 tasks), Mingbird and the native agent tie at 0.740 with opencode at 0.500. In telecom (114 tasks), Mingbird scores 1.000 with opencode at 0.991 and the native agent at 0.930 — the domain is near-saturated for all three completed arms at this model size. Because Mingbird’s telecom margin and the pooled native-agent significance both rest on this domain, one Mingbird-side mechanism belongs next to the numbers: the τ 2 \tau^{2} adapter inherits the M4 anti-loop guard (same-signature repeat ≥ \geq 4 triggers a corrective nudge, Appendix A ), which absorbs exactly the repeated-call failure mode that this domain’s long tool sequences are prone to. Counting only the two more discriminating domains (retail + airline, 164 tasks), the totals are 0.756 vs. 0.695 (native) and 0.561 (opencode), derived from the same per-trial data. Over all 278 scored tasks, Mingbird totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737 (derived from the per-trial data). The thinking configuration moves these numbers substantially (opencode’s telecom score is 0.298 with thinking on and 0.991 with it off), which is itself a harness-level effect and is discussed below. The goose arm is deferred: under the same protocol it needs 40–113 minutes per task on this benchmark — a token audit attributes this to nested sub-agent loops at ∼ {\sim} 4.85M input tokens per task, against 60–400K for the other arms — so completing 278 tasks at that throughput is a multi-day run; its legacy thinking-on numbers (retail 0.588, airline 0.460, telecom 0.377) are superseded by the protocol change.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 列出了相关数值。 在零售领域（官方 115 项任务套件中可运行的 114 项任务），Mingbird 的得分为 0.763，而原生智能体为 0.675，opencode 为 0.588。 在航空领域（50 项任务），Mingbird 与原生智能体的得分同为 0.740，而 opencode 为 0.500。 在电信领域（114 项任务），Mingbird 的得分为 1.000，opencode 为 0.991，原生智能体为 0.930——在此模型规模下，所有三个已完成分支在该领域的表现均已接近饱和。 由于 Mingbird 在电信领域的优势以及原生智能体合并后的显著性都依赖于该领域，因此需要补充一个与 Mingbird 相关的机制：τ² 适配器继承了 M4 的反循环防护（相同签名的重复序列 ≥ 4 时会触发纠正性调整，见附录 A），从而恰好吸收了该领域中长工具序列容易出现的重复调用失败模式。 仅计算更具区分度的两个领域（零售 + 航空，共 164 项任务），总得分分别为 0.756（Mingbird）与 0.695（原生智能体）、0.561（opencode），这些数据均源自相同的单次试验数据。 在所有 278 项评分任务中，Mingbird 的总得分为 0.856，而原生智能体和 opencode 分别为 0.791 和 0.737（数据源自单次试验数据）。 启用思考配置后，这些数值发生了显著变化（opencode 在电信领域的得分在开启思考时为 0.298，关闭时则为 0.991），这本身属于框架层的影响，将在下文讨论。 “鹅”分支暂不纳入比较：根据相同协议，它在此基准测试中每项任务需要 40–113 分钟——令牌审计将其归因于嵌套子智能体循环，每项任务的输入令牌量约为 485 万，而其他分支仅需 60–40 万；因此，以该吞吐量完成 278 项任务需要运行多日；其旧版“开启思考”的得分（零售 0.588、航空 0.460、电信 0.377）因协议变更而不再适用。

paragraphs.en: Errored trials score 0 for every arm. Under the unified protocol the three completed arms finished with zero errored trials across all 278 cells; the earlier thinking-on runs had shown 5 native-agent errors in each of retail and airline. We disclose error counts because the error-as-0 rule is part of what a harness comparison measures: a scaffold that crashes mid-task has not delivered.
paragraphs.zh: 出现错误的试验在所有分支中均得 0 分。 在统一协议下，三个已完成的分支在所有 278 个单元格中均未出现任何错误试验；而早期的思考运行则显示，零售和航空分支各自存在 5 次原生智能体错误。 我们公开错误计数，因为“错误计为 0”的规则正是测试框架比较所衡量内容的一部分：一个在任务中途崩溃的架构并未真正完成任务。

sents.en: Under the unified protocol the three completed arms finished with zero errored trials across all 278 cells; the earlier thinking-on runs had shown 5 native-agent errors in each of retail and airline.
sents.zh: 在统一协议下，三个已完成的分支在所有 278 个单元格中均未出现任何错误试验；而早期的思考运行则显示，零售和航空分支各自存在 5 次原生智能体错误。

sents.en: We disclose error counts because the error-as-0 rule is part of what a harness comparison measures: a scaffold that crashes mid-task has not delivered.
sents.zh: 我们公开错误计数，因为“错误计为 0”的规则正是测试框架比较所衡量内容的一部分：一个在任务中途崩溃的架构并未真正完成任务。

paragraphs.en: Because per-task outcomes are pass/fail, the primary test is the exact McNemar test on discordant pairs; the paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (which on binary outcomes reduces to a sign test) agrees to the reported digit. Over the 278 tasks of the three completed arms, Mingbird against the native agent gives a mean paired difference of + 0.065 +0.065 (40 wins / 216 ties / 22 losses, McNemar p = 0.030 p=0.030 ; Wilcoxon p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), and against opencode + 0.119 +0.119 (47 / 217 / 14, p = 2.7 × 10 − 5 p=2.7\times 10^{-5} ; Wilcoxon 2.4 × 10 − 5 2.4\times 10^{-5} ); with Holm correction across the two comparisons both remain significant (adjusted p = 0.030 p=0.030 and 5.4 × 10 − 5 5.4\times 10^{-5} ). Two qualifications belong to the result. First, on the discriminating-domain subset (retail + airline, 164 tasks; telecom is near-saturated at 0.93–1.00 for every arm and cannot separate the arms), Mingbird separates from opencode ( 46 46 / 104 104 / 14 14 , p = 4.2 × 10 − 5 p=4.2\times 10^{-5} ) but not from the native agent ( 32 32 / 110 110 / 22 22 , p = 0.22 p=0.22 ): the pooled native-agent significance leans on telecom, where Mingbird wins all 8 of its discordant tasks. Domain-wise we report as computed: the opencode comparison is significant in retail ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ) and airline ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 ) but not in telecom; the native-agent comparison is significant only in telecom ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 ), while retail alone (26 wins / 16 losses among 72 ties) does not separate at n = 114 n{=}114 . Second, the external margin is smaller than the internal one: against the common opponent opencode the paired margin is + 0.407 +0.407 on LRAB and + 0.119 +0.119 here ( 29 % 29\% retained); the native agent does not appear in the LRAB matrix, so its + 0.065 +0.065 has no internal counterpart. The tie-heavy structure (pass/fail scoring) means the pooled tests lean on the domains that discriminate.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每项任务的成果是“通过/失败”形式，因此主要检验是对不一致配对进行精确的麦克尼马尔检验；配对威尔科克森符号秩检验（在二元成果下简化为符号检验）的结果与所报告的数字一致。 在三组已完成任务共 278 项中，Mingbird 与原生智能体相比的平均配对差异为 +0.065 +0.065（40 次胜利 / 216 次平局 / 22 次失败，麦克尼马尔 p = 0.030 p=0.030；威尔科克森 p = 0.022 p=0.022），而与 opencode 相比的平均差异为 +0.119 +0.119（47 / 217 / 14，p = 2.7 × 10⁻⁵ p=2.7\times 10^{-5}；威尔科克森 p = 2.4 × 10⁻⁵ 2.4\times 10^{-5}）；在对两个比较进行霍尔姆校正后，两者均保持显著（调整后的 p = 0.030 p=0.030 和 5.4 × 10⁻⁵ 5.4\times 10^{-5}）。 该结果存在两点限定条件。 首先，在区分性领域子集（零售 + 航空，共 164 项任务；电信领域的得分在每组中均已接近饱和（0.93–1.00），无法区分各组）中，Mingbird 与 opencode 存在显著差异（46 / 104 / 14，p = 4.2 × 10⁻⁵ p=4.2\times 10^{-5}），但与原生智能体无显著差异（32 / 110 / 22，p = 0.22 p=0.22）；原生智能体的合并显著性主要依赖于电信领域，因为 Mingbird 在该领域的 8 个不一致任务中全部获胜。 按领域分别报告计算结果：opencode 的比较在零售（p = 0.002 p=0.002）和航空（p = 0.005 p=0.005）领域显著，但在电信领域不显著；原生智能体的比较仅在电信领域显著（p = 0.005 p=0.005），而仅看零售领域（72 次平局中有 26 次胜利 / 16 次失败），在 n = 114 n{=}114 时无法区分各组。 其次，外部差异幅度小于内部差异幅度：在与共同对手 opencode 的对比中，LRAB 上的配对差异为 +0.407 +0.407，此处则为 +0.119 +0.119（保留率 29% 29\%）；原生智能体未出现在 LRAB 矩阵中，因此其 +0.065 +0.065 没有对应的内部差异值。 这种以平局为主的结构（通过/失败评分方式）意味着合并检验主要依赖于那些具有区分性的领域。

paragraphs.en: Because the unified protocol pins thinking off, we also hold the earlier thinking-on runs as a sensitivity view. The configuration moves arms, not noise: opencode’s retail score goes 0.246 → \to 0.588 and telecom 0.298 → \to 0.991 when thinking is disabled; the native agent’s airline score goes 0.520 → \to 0.740 while its saturated telecom mean drops 1.000 → \to 0.930; Mingbird moves least (retail 0.789 → \to 0.763). The same lever appears inside LRAB (opencode 12B 0.140 → \to 0.539; goose 35B 0.822 → \to 0.679). A harness’s thinking policy is thus a first-class design decision with task-dependent costs and benefits — one more axis on which harnesses differ even when the model is fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 由于统一协议禁用了思考功能，我们将之前的启用思考的运行结果也作为敏感性视角保留。 配置影响的是得分而非噪声：当禁用思考时，opencode 的零售得分从 0.246 → \to 0.588，电信得分从 0.298 → \to 0.991；原生智能体的航空得分从 0.520 → \to 0.740，而其饱和电信均值则从 1.000 → \to 0.930；Mingbird 的变化最小（零售得分从 0.789 → \to 0.763）。 同样的调节机制也出现在 LRAB 中（opencode 12B 的得分从 0.140 → \to 0.539；goose 35B 的得分从 0.822 → \to 0.679）。 因此，框架的思考策略是一项一级设计决策，其成本与收益取决于具体任务——即使模型固定不变，这也是框架之间差异的又一个维度。

paragraphs.en: Granting every arm its more favorable thinking configuration does not change the ranking. On τ 2 \tau^{2} , both configurations are per-trial published (the thinking-on batch is archived alongside the unified one), so the comparison is recomputable: taking each arm’s better configuration gives Mingbird 0.867 (its best is thinking-on), the native agent 0.791 (best off), and opencode 0.737 (best off), against the unified-protocol 0.856 / 0.791 / 0.737. Notably, Mingbird is the arm whose total moves least between configurations ( ± 0.011 \pm 0.011 ), while rival arms move far more at the domain level (opencode’s telecom pass rate swings from 0.298 with thinking on to 0.991 with it off); the unified protocol is therefore not what produces the gap. On LRAB, the legacy thinking-on batch is summarized only in aggregate (per-tier examples above, marked as legacy), and the direction is tier-dependent for rivals: goose gains from thinking at 35B (0.822 vs. 0.679) and on the long-horizon tasks (0.623 vs. 0.394) but loses at 4B/12B (e.g. 0.636 vs. 0.801 at 4B, legacy vs. unified), while opencode’s 12B goes the other way (0.140 vs. 0.539). No single thinking configuration is uniformly best across harnesses — which is itself the finding.
paragraphs.zh: 为每个臂分配更有利的思考配置并不会改变排名。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} 时，两种配置都会在每次试验中发布（“思考开启”批次的结果会与统一批次一同归档），因此可以进行重新比较：采用每个臂的更优配置后，Mingbird 得分为 0.867（其最佳配置为“思考开启”），原生智能体得分为 0.791（最佳配置为“思考关闭”），opencode 得分为 0.737（最佳配置也为“思考关闭”）；而统一协议下的得分分别为 0.856 / 0.791 / 0.737。 值得注意的是，Mingbird 是在不同配置间总变化最小的臂（± 0.011 \pm 0.011），而其他竞争臂在领域层级的变化则大得多（例如 opencode 的电信通过率从“思考开启”时的 0.298 变为“思考关闭”时的 0.991）；因此，造成差异的并非统一协议本身。 在 LRAB 上，旧版“思考开启”批次仅以汇总形式呈现（如上文各层级示例中标注为“旧版”），且竞争臂的表现方向因层级而异：goose 在 35B（0.822 vs. 0.679）和长周期任务（0.623 vs. 0.394）中因开启思考而获益，但在 4B/12B 上则表现更差（例如 4B 时旧版为 0.636，统一协议为 0.801）；而 opencode 的 12B 结果则相反（0.140 vs. 0.539）。 没有任何一种思考配置能在所有测试环境中都保持最佳——这一发现本身即具有重要意义。

paragraphs.en: The user simulator is qwen3.8-flash , not the official gpt-4o user, so absolute scores are not comparable to the published leaderboard. All four arms share the identical simulator, tool schemas, and policy prompts, so the between-arm comparison is controlled even though the absolute numbers are not leaderboard-comparable. Per-trial traces and the scoring manifests ship with the published data package.
paragraphs.zh: 用户模拟器是 qwen3.8-flash，而非官方的 gpt-4o 用户，因此绝对分数无法与已发布的排行榜进行比较。 所有四个分支均共享相同的模拟器、工具模式和策略提示，因此尽管绝对数值无法与排行榜数据比较，但分支间的比较仍然是受控的。 每次试验的追踪数据和评分记录均已包含在发布的数据包中。

paragraphs.en: The matrix of Table 5 varies the model at fixed local hardware and the τ 2 \tau^{2} check of Section 5.4 varies the domain; neither isolates the harness’s own contribution. We therefore ran a decomposition probe: all 18 LRAB tasks, four harnesses, and a single fixed frontier model — the hosted qwen3.8-flash — in place of local weights. A local shim presents the cloud endpoint as an Ollama service, so every harness runs unmodified against it; temperature is 0 and thinking is disabled, matching the unified protocol. One version caveat: the probe drives the product repository’s working tree at its run date (the post-v1.7.0 tree on 2026-09-20; the mechanism-ablation re-run used the v1.8.2-era tree), not the frozen v1.5.0 snapshot of the main matrix, so probe-versus-matrix juxtapositions are cross-version for the Mingbird arm (Appendix B ). Budgets are 60 minutes per workflow task and 90 per long-horizon task, scored by the same deterministic rubric. This is a probe, not part of the 288-cell matrix: the model is a cloud API rather than local weights, and per-cell cost bounds us to one trial per arm.
paragraphs.zh: 表5的矩阵通过固定本地硬件来改变模型，而第5.4节的τ²检查则通过改变领域来实现；两者都无法单独隔离出harness本身的贡献。 因此，我们进行了一项分解探测：所有18个LRAB任务、四个harness以及一个固定的前沿模型——托管的qwen3.8-flash——取代了本地权重。 一个本地适配器将云端点呈现为Ollama服务，因此每个harness都以未修改的形式与其交互；温度设为0且思考功能已禁用，这与统一协议一致。 一个版本相关的注意事项：该探测在运行日期（即2026年9月20日的post-v1.7.0版本树；机制消融的重新运行使用了v1.8.2时代的树）驱动了产品仓库的工作树，而非主矩阵中冻结的v1.5.0快照，因此探测与矩阵之间的对比对于Mingbird分支而言是跨版本的（附录B）。 预算为每个工作流任务60分钟，每个长期任务90分钟，并由相同的确定性评分标准进行评分。 这是一项探测，而非288单元格矩阵的一部分：模型使用的是云API而非本地权重，且每个单元格的成本限制使我们每个分支只能进行一次试验。

sents.en: The matrix of Table 5 varies the model at fixed local hardware and the τ 2 \tau^{2} check of Section 5.4 varies the domain; neither isolates the harness’s own contribution.
sents.zh: 表5的矩阵通过固定本地硬件来改变模型，而第5.4节的τ²检查则通过改变领域来实现；两者都无法单独隔离出harness本身的贡献。

sents.en: We therefore ran a decomposition probe: all 18 LRAB tasks, four harnesses, and a single fixed frontier model — the hosted qwen3.8-flash — in place of local weights.
sents.zh: 因此，我们进行了一项分解探测：所有18个LRAB任务、四个harness以及一个固定的前沿模型——托管的qwen3.8-flash——取代了本地权重。

sents.en: A local shim presents the cloud endpoint as an Ollama service, so every harness runs unmodified against it; temperature is 0 and thinking is disabled, matching the unified protocol.
sents.zh: 一个本地适配器将云端点呈现为Ollama服务，因此每个harness都以未修改的形式与其交互；温度设为0且思考功能已禁用，这与统一协议一致。

sents.en: One version caveat: the probe drives the product repository’s working tree at its run date (the post-v1.7.0 tree on 2026-09-20; the mechanism-ablation re-run used the v1.8.2-era tree), not the frozen v1.5.0 snapshot of the main matrix, so probe-versus-matrix juxtapositions are cross-version for the Mingbird arm (Appendix B ).
sents.zh: 一个版本相关的注意事项：该探测在运行日期（即2026年9月20日的post-v1.7.0版本树；机制消融的重新运行使用了v1.8.2时代的树）驱动了产品仓库的工作树，而非主矩阵中冻结的v1.5.0快照，因此探测与矩阵之间的对比对于Mingbird分支而言是跨版本的（附录B）。

sents.en: Budgets are 60 minutes per workflow task and 90 per long-horizon task, scored by the same deterministic rubric.
sents.zh: 预算为每个工作流任务60分钟，每个长期任务90分钟，并由相同的确定性评分标准进行评分。

sents.en: This is a probe, not part of the 288-cell matrix: the model is a cloud API rather than local weights, and per-cell cost bounds us to one trial per arm.
sents.zh: 这是一项探测，而非288单元格矩阵的一部分：模型使用的是云API而非本地权重，且每个单元格的成本限制使我们每个分支只能进行一次试验。

paragraphs.en: Three observations. First, the headline spread of 0.52 (0.997 vs. 0.478) is carried entirely by one arm: the three well-formed scaffolds span only 0.072 (0.925–0.997). Read the same table the other way — fix the harness, swap the model (local 4B column of Table 5 vs. this probe) — and the model lever is larger: Mingbird + 0.121 +0.121 , goose + 0.188 +0.188 , opencode + 0.460 +0.460 ; only agent-mini moves the other way ( − 0.228 -0.228 ), and it is the arm whose scaffold is defective. The probe therefore supports a narrower claim than “the harness is the binding constraint”: a defective scaffold can bury more than half of a frontier model’s measured capability, while among well-formed scaffolds the frontier-tier spread is 0.072–0.12 — consistent with the harness-effect literature (Section 2 ) instantiated at the local tier, and consistent with the model remaining the dominant lever between intact harnesses. The probe and the main matrix are here read side by side across different budgets — 60/90 minutes per task in the probe against 90/180 in the matrix — so this juxtaposition is a qualitative cross-budget comparison, not a like-for-like one. Second, Mingbird is the only arm at ceiling both here and in the local matrix; its advantage does not depend on model class. Third, the per-cell failures are mechanistic, not stochastic: on WF-03 opencode’s model replies “what task?” and exits (a prompt-delivery failure the same model does not show under the other scaffolds), and on WF-08 opencode blocks forever on a foreground server while goose finishes the same task in 776 seconds — process management and task delivery differ across harnesses even when the model is fixed. agent-mini’s second-scale early exits persist unchanged, confirming that its deficit is in the scaffold, not the model it was given.
paragraphs.zh: 三个观察结果。 首先，0.52（0.997 对比 0.478）的标题级表现差异完全由一个分支承担：三个结构完整的支架仅跨越 0.072（0.925–0.997）。 以另一种方式解读同一张表——固定约束层，更换模型（表 5 中的本地 4B 列与此探针对比）——模型杠杆效应会更大：Mingbird +0.121、goose +0.188、opencode +0.460；只有 agent-mini 的表现反向移动（−0.228），而它正是支架存在缺陷的分支。 因此，该探针支持比“约束层是绑定限制”更狭窄的结论：一个有缺陷的支架可能掩盖前沿模型超过一半的实测能力，而在结构完整的支架中，前沿级别的表现差异为 0.072–0.12——这与约束层效应的相关文献（第 2 节）在本地层级上的具体表现一致，也符合模型在完整约束层之间仍为主要决定因素的情况。 此处将探针与主矩阵在不同预算水平下并列解读——探针中每项任务耗时 60/90 分钟，而矩阵中为 90/180 分钟——因此这种并置是一种跨预算的定性比较，而非同类条件下的直接对比。 其次，Mingbird 是此处以及本地矩阵中唯一达到上限的分支；其优势不依赖于模型类别。 第三，每个单元格的失败具有机制性而非随机性：在 WF-03 中，opencode 的模型回复“什么任务？”后退出（这是该模型在其他支架下不会出现提示传递失败的情况）；而在 WF-08 中，opencode 在前台服务器上永久阻塞，而 goose 完成同一任务仅需 776 秒——即使模型固定不变，不同约束层之间的进程管理与任务交付仍存在差异。agent-mini 在第二规模上的提前退出情况保持不变，证实其缺陷在于支架，而非所赋予的模型本身。

paragraphs.en: The campaign totals 3,126 model calls and 53.7M prompt tokens across all four arms; per-cell traces and scores are retained with the project’s benchmark artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 整个活动在所有四个分支中总计使用了 3,126 次模型调用和 5370 万个提示词标记；每个单元的痕迹和分数均已保留在项目基准测试成果中。

paragraphs.en: To move from the design narrative of Section 3.2 toward marginal-contribution estimates, we ran an ablation on the v1.5.0 code base: four variants, each with one mechanism disabled through an AGENT_ABLATION environment gate, over the same 18 LRAB tasks with gemma4:e2b ( n = 18 n=18 cells per arm). The disabled mechanisms are the finish gate (M3), the verification-feedback loop (part of M3), the signature-level anti-loop monitor (M4), and the category-routed flat prefill (M1); the ablation thus covers three mechanisms (M1, the two halves of M3, and M4) across four variant arms, while M2 (chat/task layering) and M5 (format rescue) are not ablated and remain the two named mechanisms whose benefits this paper does not quantify. The four variant arms ran 2026-09-14..15; the same-night re-run arms and their three replications ran 2026-09-22 on the v1.8.2-era tree (Appendix B ). The baseline is the full-mechanism arm of the same code base, and its 18 cells are reused directly from the 2B column of Table 5 (same code); the four variant arms are independent new executions over those tasks, under the same temperature-0 configuration as the main matrix. There is therefore a batch gap between the baseline arm and the variant arms, and the common-cause disclosure below stems from it. Each variant wrote an independent results directory, scored by the same deterministic rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 为了从第 3.2 节的设计叙述转向边际贡献估计，我们对 v1.5.0 代码库执行了消融实验：共四个变体，每个变体通过 AGENT_ABLATION 环境门禁用一种机制，并在相同的 18 个 LRAB 任务上运行，使用 gemma4:e2b（每臂 n = 18 n=18 个单元）。 被禁用的机制包括结束门（M3）、验证反馈循环（M3 的一部分）、签名级反循环监控器（M4）以及按类别路由的扁平预填充（M1）；因此，该消融实验覆盖了四个变体臂中的三种机制（M1、M3 的两个部分以及 M4），而 M2（聊天/任务分层）和 M5（格式恢复）并未被消融，仍然是本文未量化其益处的两种明确机制。 四个变体臂的运行时间为 2026-09-14..15；同一晚的重运行臂及其三次重复实验则于 2026-09-22 在 v1.8.2 版本的代码树上运行（附录 B）。 基线是同一代码库中完整机制的变体臂，其 18 个单元直接复用自表 5 的 2B 列（相同代码）；四个变体臂则是针对这些任务独立执行的新实验，采用与主矩阵相同的温度-0 配置。 因此，基线臂与变体臂之间存在批次差异，下文提到的共同原因披露即由此产生。 每个变体都生成了一个独立的结果目录，并由相同的确定性评分标准进行评分。

paragraphs.en: The two gate variants are separable in the implementation, and the separation is mechanical: AGENT_ABLATION =finish_gate bypasses four of the six finish-time interventions (no-work finish refusal, the pytest test guard, summary-to-artifact cross-checking, and plan-completeness checking); two interventions are not gated by this switch and stayed active in both arms — the todo-sync reminder (which refuses a finish while the model’s own declared plan shows unchecked items) and the delivery self-check, which re-injects the task’s original text once and asks the model to self-check before the second, accepted finish. This matters for interpretation: the textual re-read — the part of M3 the abstract highlights — is present in both arms, so the − 0.098 -0.098 measures the four executable guards on top of the re-read, not the re-read itself. AGENT_ABLATION = verify_feedback leaves every guard active but downgrades the failure feedback inside pytest refusals — the precise injected hint (failing test, file, line, assertion) is replaced by the last line of the pytest output only. The two switches therefore measure different things: removing the gate removes the executable-refusal behavior; removing verification feedback keeps refusals but starves the model of the exact failure location it would need to recover in one step. The nearest published neighbors are tool-interactive self-critique (CRITIC [ 57 ] ) and programmatic verification loops in code agents (AutoCodeRover [ 58 ] ); M3 applies the same verify-before-finish principle at the harness level, for general local tasks rather than code alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种门控变体在实现中是可分离的，且这种分离是机械性的：AGENT_ABLATION =finish_gate 绕过了六个结束时间干预项中的四个（无操作结束拒绝、pytest 测试守卫、摘要到工件的交叉验证以及计划完整性检查）；有两个干预项不受此开关控制，并在两个分支中保持活跃——即 todo-sync 提醒（当模型自身声明的计划显示仍有未检查项时，会拒绝结束任务）和交付自我检查（该机制会将任务的原始文本重新注入一次，并要求模型在第二次被接受的结束前进行自我检查）。 这一点对于解释结果很重要：文本重读部分——即摘要中强调的 M3 的一部分——在两个分支中都存在，因此 −0.098 这一数值衡量的是重读之外叠加的四个可执行守卫，而非重读本身。 AGENT_ABLATION = verify_feedback 使所有守卫保持活跃，但降低了 pytest 拒绝中的失败反馈强度——即精确注入的提示（失败的测试、文件、行号和断言）被替换为仅保留 pytest 输出的最后一行。 因此，这两个开关衡量的是不同的事物：移除门控会消除可执行拒绝行为；而移除验证反馈则保留了拒绝机制，但使模型无法获得它单步恢复所需的精确失败位置信息。 最接近的已发表相关研究包括工具交互式自我批判（CRITIC [57]）以及代码智能体中的程序化验证循环（AutoCodeRover [58]）；M3 则将相同的“结束前验证”原则应用到了通用本地任务层面，而不仅限于代码本身。

paragraphs.en: The pytest guard fires only when the working directory contains test_*.py at finish time. Two of the 18 tasks stage benchmark-provided test files into the workdir (WF-04 stages test_inventory.py ; LH-03 stages test_suite.py ); on those two tasks the harness at finish time executes the same fixture the scorer executes later (the scorer’s spec_pytest and script_pass checks run the same files), so there the acceptance criterion is literally runnable before scoring. On the other 16 tasks the guard fires only on test files the agent itself wrote, and the three other ablated guards act on information the scorer only partially shares: the claim-check and the scorer both test file existence, but the claim-check runs on whatever the model claimed in its finish summary, and the no-work and plan-completeness guards act on run-time information — productive tool use and the agent’s own declared plan — that the scorer never sees (the published scoring is fully deterministic — milestone and final-artifact checks only; the scorer’s optional LLM-judge component was disabled for every published batch, so no judge enters any LRAB number in this paper). The per-task decomposition bounds how much of the effect this overlap can explain: the net − 0.098 -0.098 is carried by four tasks at roughly + 0.71 +0.71 each (LH-01, WF-13, WF-04, WF-02) against three tasks the gate hurt (WF-07 − 0.571 -0.571 , WF-10 − 0.322 -0.322 , WF-15 − 0.143 -0.143 ). We still flag the WF-04/LH-03 overlap as a threat to validity, and note the external contrast: on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, where the finish gate cannot execute any acceptance check (scoring is database end-state plus judge), the harness margin persists at + 0.065 +0.065 to + 0.119 +0.119 .

paragraphs.en: The archived transcripts let us count how often each mechanism actually fired across the 72 Mingbird cells of the released matrix (counting log markers; the extraction script and full CSVs are in benchmarks/mechanism_log/ ): delivery self-check (task-text re-injection) 65 times, todo-sync refusals 43, summary-to-artifact cross-checks 23, pytest-guard refusals 13, plan-completeness refusals 11, and the no-work finish refusal zero — on these tasks the model always did nominal work before finishing, so that guard contributes nothing to the margins above, consistent with the per-task decomposition. The anti-loop family intervened 95 times (mostly repeated-call intercepts), plan-staleness nudges fired 99 times, the edit-safety guard 9 times, and format rescue 4 times. Tool-call volume per cell (median): Mingbird 33.5, goose 15.0, opencode 5.0, agent-mini 7.0 (transcript formats differ across arms, so only magnitudes are comparable); Mingbird is the most tool-intensive arm, which is the intended behavior of a harness that keeps a small model moving through concrete steps. Peak prompt usage per Mingbird turn (the archived context counters are the backend’s own prompt_eval_count readings) has median 14,624 tokens and maximum 32,767 — the configured 32K budget — so even the heaviest cells finish inside the flat-prefill regime rather than overflowing it. Wall-clock medians per cell run 440 s (Mingbird), 692 s (goose), 450 s (opencode) and 116 s (agent-mini); only one of the 288 published cells was terminated by its budget (goose, WF-08), and the per-arm table with turns, tool calls, token counters and the timeout census is in benchmarks/mechanism_log/resource_table_2609.md .
paragraphs.zh: 存档的转录记录让我们能够统计每种机制在已释放矩阵的 72 个 Mingbird 单元格中实际触发的次数（统计日志标记；提取脚本和完整的 CSV 文件位于 benchmarks/mechanism_log/）：交付自我检查（任务文本重新注入）65 次，todo-sync 拒绝 43 次，摘要到工件的交叉检查 23 次，pytest-guard 拒绝 13 次，计划完整性拒绝 11 次，以及无工作完成拒绝为 0 次——在这些任务中，模型在完成前始终执行了常规工作，因此该防护对上述差异没有贡献，这与按任务分解的结果一致。 反循环机制家族干预了 95 次（主要是重复调用拦截），计划陈旧提示触发了 99 次，编辑安全防护触发 9 次，格式修复触发 4 次。 每个单元格的工具调用量（中位数）：Mingbird 33.5，goose 15.0，opencode 5.0，agent-mini 7.0（不同分支的转录格式不同，因此仅能比较数量级）；Mingbird 是工具使用最密集的分支，这也是该框架让小模型持续执行具体步骤的预期行为。 每个 Mingbird 轮次的峰值提示使用量（存档的上下文计数器是后端自身的 prompt_eval_count 读数）中位数为 14,624 个词元，最大值为 32,767 个词元——即配置的 32K 预算——因此即使最重的单元格也在平坦预填充机制内完成，而非超出该机制。 每个单元格运行的实际运行时间中位数分别为：440 秒（Mingbird）、692 秒（goose）、450 秒（opencode）和 116 秒（agent-mini）；在已发布的 288 个单元格中，只有一个因预算限制而终止（goose，WF-08），各分支的轮次、工具调用、词元计数器和超时统计表位于 benchmarks/mechanism_log/resource_table_2609.md。

paragraphs.en: Counting mechanism firings shows that the mechanisms are exercised; coding what went wrong in each cell shows what they are exercised against . Table 8 codes all 288 published cells. The baselines’ dominant form is not a wrong answer but an unattempted or abandoned one: opencode never invoked a single tool in 21 of its 72 cells (18 of them at 2B, consistent with its zero tool-call mean at that tier), agent-mini lost 8 cells to backend disconnects that its own runner records as completed , and 23–44 cells per baseline arm stopped short of the product checks with no crash and no timeout. In the Mingbird arm the behaviour that ends a baseline cell is instead an event the harness intercepts: 40 cells contain a finish call the gate refused because a named artifact was missing, and only 4 Mingbird cells end below half credit. These counts are incidence, not causal attribution — in the sampled cells three interceptions fired in cells that went on to full credit, and the mechanism-activation counts above include the same non-fatal firings. A second coder, reading a stratified 24-cell sample independently, agreed with the extraction script on every sampled cell for the record-derived and marker-derived forms (24/24 and 6/6 respectively); for the single judgment form ( stopped short ) the two agreed on 21/24, all three disagreements falling on the 0.5 0.5 score boundary or on the choice between the task-total and the final-stage score.
paragraphs.zh: 计数机制的触发表明这些机制已被执行；编码每个单元格中出错的内容则揭示了它们是针对什么被执行的。 表8对已发表的288个单元格进行了全部编码。 基线模型的主要形式并非错误答案，而是未尝试或已放弃的答案：在72个单元格中，opencode有21个从未调用过任何工具（其中2B层级有18个，与其在该层级平均零次工具调用的结果一致），agent-mini因后端断开连接而损失了8个单元格，但其自身的运行器记录这些单元格为已完成；此外，每个基线分支中有23至44个单元格在未崩溃或未超时的情况下未能通过最终检查。 在Mingbird分支中，结束基线单元格的行为则是一种被框架拦截的事件：40个单元格包含一个“结束”调用，但因缺少指定名称的产物而被拒绝；仅有4个Mingbird单元格的得分低于一半。 这些计数反映的是发生频率，而非因果归因——在抽样单元格中，有三次拦截发生在最终获得完整得分的单元格内，且上述机制激活的计数也包含了这些非致命性触发。 第二位编码者独立阅读了一个分层抽取的24个单元格样本，在与记录来源形式和标记来源形式的提取脚本上对所有抽样单元格均达成一致（分别为24/24和6/6）；对于单一判断形式（未通过），两人在24个单元格中一致判断了21个，所有三个分歧均出现在0.5分界线上，或是在任务总分与最终阶段得分之间的选择上。

paragraphs.en: Because the harness and the benchmark share authors, we disclose what each ablated mechanism was developed against. The finish gate and the anti-loop monitor were iterated with LRAB in the loop : their v1.2.0 forms were explicit responses to LRAB long-horizon failures (early-finish abandonment; a same-tool-call rule that disarmed legitimate batch work), and the WF-08 incident (156 calls, zero artifacts → \to 15 calls, three artifacts, prefill byte-identical) drove the anti-loop escalation ladder. The verification-feedback hint predates LRAB (developed against an earlier internal benchmark, 2026-08-19..26, before LRAB existed on 2026-08-28), with LRAB-period strengthening after a WF-08 12B failure. The flat prefill also predates LRAB (root cause: a Q&A tool-demonstration loop, 2026-08-20) and, as Section 5.6 notes, is inert on LRAB’s narrow tool surface. Consequently, the − 0.098 -0.098 finish-gate and − 0.015 -0.015 anti-loop deltas should be read as in-sample effect estimates for mechanisms co-developed with the task set — which is why the ablation is reported as directional throughout. Of the four ablated arms, three carry some in-sample exposure (the finish gate and anti-loop monitor were iterated with LRAB in the loop; the verification-feedback hint predates LRAB but was strengthened during the LRAB period), and only the flat prefill is both pre-LRAB and, by its near-zero delta, inert here; the external τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench comparison — same code, no benchmark-provided tests for the gate to run — is the out-of-sample anchor for the mechanisms the ablation cannot cleanly measure.

paragraphs.en: Table 9 gives the totals, and Figure 9 decomposes the per-task changes by task family. No removal helps, and the gradient is consistent with the design motivation of Section 3.2 , but it is directional rather than statistically significant: task-level bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (10,000 resamples) are wide and all cross zero (finish gate [ − 0.266 , + 0.063 ] [-0.266,+0.063] , verification feedback [ − 0.185 , + 0.076 ] [-0.185,+0.076] , anti-loop [ − 0.134 , + 0.092 ] [-0.134,+0.092] , flat prefill [ − 0.119 , + 0.093 ] [-0.119,+0.093] ). At n = 18 n=18 per arm the design cannot separate mechanism effects from task-level variance, so we read the ordering rather than any single value: removing the finish gate reduces the total by 0.098, the verification-feedback loop is next (a reduction of 0.048), and the anti-loop monitor contributes less at this scale ( − 0.015 -0.015 ). Removing the flat prefill is close to neutral at 2B ( − 0.003 -0.003 ), and we interpret this near-neutral result as a property of the task set: the mechanism’s benefit is domain routing — keeping each task’s prefill small when the total tool surface is large — and tasks whose tool surface is already narrow do not exercise it. We therefore do not claim every mechanism is necessary on this evidence; the flat prefill is an enabler of the byte-level budget guarantee (its cost is bounded by a unit test and CI) rather than a score-maximizing one, and a harness stripped of the neutral mechanisms is a reasonable variant for future work. The ablation covers one model at 2B and 18 tasks per arm; it does not establish marginal contributions at 4B or above (discussed in Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表9给出了总计数据，而图9则按任务类别分解了每个任务的变动情况。 移除任何组件都无济于事，且梯度与第3.2节的设计动机一致，但其方向性显著而非统计显著：任务级别的自助法95%置信区间（10,000次重采样）范围较宽，且均穿过零（结束门 [−0.266, +0.063] [-0.266,+0.063]、验证反馈 [−0.185, +0.076] [-0.185,+0.076]、反循环 [−0.134, +0.092] [-0.134,+0.092]、平坦预填充 [−0.119, +0.093] [-0.119,+0.093]）。 当每臂 n = 18 时，该设计无法区分机制效应与任务级别的方差，因此我们关注排序而非单个数值：移除结束门会使总计减少0.098，其次是验证反馈循环（减少0.048），而反循环监控器在此规模下的贡献较小（−0.015）。 在2B模型中，移除平坦预填充的影响接近中性（−0.003），我们将这一近乎中性的结果解释为任务集的特性：该机制的优势在于领域路由——当工具总表面积较大时保持每个任务的预填充较小——而工具表面积本身已较窄的任务则无法利用这一特性。 因此，基于现有证据，我们并不声称所有机制都是必需的；平坦预填充更多是字节级预算保证的实现手段（其成本受单元测试和持续集成限制），而非用于最大化得分的组件，一个去除了中性机制的测试框架可成为未来研究的合理变体。 该消融研究覆盖了2B模型以及每臂18个任务的情况；它并未确定4B或更高规模下的边际贡献（详见第6节）。

paragraphs.en: One per-task pattern must be disclosed before any mechanism is read out of Table 9 . LH-01 falls to 0.214–0.259 in all four ablation arms, from a baseline of 0.929: a drop of 0.670–0.715 whose range across the four arms is only 0.045. Four different disabled mechanisms, four independent executions, and the same task falls by the same amount each time — this does not behave like a mechanism effect but like a common cause: LH-01 is a 180-minute multi-stage task, the most sensitive task in the set to batch conditions, and it may itself be bimodal. Excluding LH-01 from all five arms, the deltas become: finish gate − 0.098 → − 0.062 -0.098\to-0.062 (the direction survives, 37% smaller), verification feedback − 0.048 → − 0.011 -0.048\to-0.011 (approaching zero), anti-loop − 0.015 → + 0.023 -0.015\to+0.023 (sign flip), and flat prefill − 0.003 → + 0.037 -0.003\to+0.037 (sign flip). Only the finish gate survives in direction once the common-cause task is excluded; the nominal anti-loop and flat-prefill effects are entirely explained by that single cell.
paragraphs.zh: 在从表9中读取任何机制之前，必须披露每个任务的单一模式。 在所有四个消融分支中，LH-01均降至0.214–0.259，而基线为0.929：下降了0.670–0.715，且四个分支间的差异仅为0.045。 四种不同的禁用机制、四次独立的执行，以及同一任务每次都以相同的幅度下降——这并非机制效应，而是共同原因的表现：LH-01是一项持续180分钟的多阶段任务，是该集合中对批量条件最敏感的任务，其本身可能具有双峰分布。 若将LH-01从全部五个分支中排除，则差异变为：完成门 −0.098 → −0.062（方向保留，但幅度缩小37%），验证反馈 −0.048 → −0.011（趋近于零），反循环 −0.015 → +0.023（符号反转），以及平坦预填充 −0.003 → +0.037（符号反转）。 一旦排除这一由共同原因引起的任务，仅完成门的效应方向得以保留；而名义上的反循环和平坦预填充效应则完全可由该单一单元格解释。

paragraphs.en: The follow-up experiment settles it. We re-ran the full-mechanism arm fresh on 2026-09-22 (v1.5.0 code, same model manifest, same budgets, the same judge-free deterministic scoring as the ablation protocol) plus one new arm, finish_gate_text_only , which keeps only the completion-time re-injection of the task text and disables the four executable guards and the todo-sync reminder. Two findings:
paragraphs.zh: 后续实验解决了这个问题。 我们在 2026-09-22 重新运行了完整机制组（v1.5.0 代码、相同的模型清单、相同的预算，以及消融协议中使用的相同无裁判的确定性评分），并增加了一个新组 finish_gate_text_only：该组仅保留任务文本的完成时间重新注入功能，同时禁用了四个可执行守卫和 todo-sync 提醒。研究得出两点发现：

sents.en: We re-ran the full-mechanism arm fresh on 2026-09-22 (v1.5.0 code, same model manifest, same budgets, the same judge-free deterministic scoring as the ablation protocol) plus one new arm, finish_gate_text_only , which keeps only the completion-time re-injection of the task text and disables the four executable guards and the todo-sync reminder. Two findings:
sents.zh: 我们在 2026-09-22 重新运行了完整机制组（v1.5.0 代码、相同的模型清单、相同的预算，以及消融协议中使用的相同无裁判的确定性评分），并增加了一个新组 finish_gate_text_only：该组仅保留任务文本的完成时间重新注入功能，同时禁用了四个可执行守卫和 todo-sync 提醒。研究得出两点发现：

paragraphs.en: The common cause is confirmed, and it is not limited to LH-01. The fresh full-mechanism arm lands in the low mode by itself: LH-01 0.286 (matrix batch 0.929), LH-02 0.191 (0.878), LH-03 0.420 (0.969); the 18-task mean is 0.740 against the matrix batch’s 0.821, with single-cell swings on workflow tasks of up to ± 0.43 \pm 0.43 . With every mechanism enabled, the drop reproduces, so the LH-family movement in Table 9 carries no mechanism-level information. The same reruns also fix the scale against which the deltas must be read: single-cell swings reach ± 0.5 \pm 0.5 on long-horizon tasks, and — the like-for-like comparator — same-night replications of the same arm move its 18-task mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal delta in the table. The four published deltas, including the finish gate’s − 0.098 -0.098 , are directional estimates from single trials, not measured marginal effects.
paragraphs.zh: 共同原因已得到确认，且该原因并不仅限于 LH-01。 全新全机制臂能够自行进入低模式：LH-01 为 0.286（矩阵批次 0.929），LH-02 为 0.191（0.878），LH-03 为 0.420（0.969）；18 项任务的均值为 0.740，而矩阵批次的均值为 0.821，工作流任务中的单细胞波动幅度最高可达 ±0.43 \pm 0.43。 在所有机制均启用时，该下降现象再次出现，因此表 9 中 LH 系列的动作不包含任何机制层面的信息。 这些重复运行也确定了必须据此解读差异值的标度：在长期任务中，单细胞波动可达 ±0.5 \pm 0.5；而在同类对比中，同一夜晚对同一臂的重复操作会使 18 项任务的均值最多变化 0.069，这相当于表中每个名义差异值的大小。 已发表的四个差异值（包括完成门的 −0.098 -0.098）均是基于单次试验的方向性估计，而非测得的边际效应。

paragraphs.en: The one clean matched comparison favors the executable guards. The two new arms ran in one batch on the same night, so their pairing is the only comparison in this section not separated by a batch gap. To move past single trials we repeated the matched pair three times (three independent same-night batch runs of each arm, 18 tasks each, published as ablation_reps_2609.csv ). paragraphs.en: LRAB’s tasks and rubrics were authored by the same people who built Mingbird. We cannot rule out that the task set favors our harness’s mechanisms; indeed, it was designed to exercise the failure forms in Section 3.2 , which is the point of a controlled experiment but also its bias. Mitigations include the full publication of tasks, fixtures, scoring code, and raw cells, in the spirit of reproducible agent evaluation [ 59 ] ; the explicit framing as a controlled experiment rather than a leaderboard; and the external τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench replication, whose benchmark, tasks, and scorer are third-party. The two legs agree in direction.
paragraphs.zh: LRAB 的任务和评分标准由构建 Mingbird 的同一团队编写。 我们不能排除任务集偏向我们 harness 机制的可能性；事实上，它的设计初衷就是测试第 3.2 节中提到的失败形式，这正是受控实验的意义所在，但也是其偏见来源。 缓解措施包括完整发布任务、固定组件、评分代码和原始单元格，以体现可重复的智能体评估精神 [59]；明确将其框架定义为受控实验而非排行榜；以及通过外部 τ²-bench 进行复现，该基准测试、任务和评分器均来自第三方。 两个阶段的结论方向一致。

paragraphs.en: τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench is our only three-arm external comparison (a fourth CLI arm, goose, is deferred for throughput), and it comes from one family (one lab, three domains). This is not for lack of searching; it reflects a structural constraint. A harness comparison requires the harness to be the experimental variable, which excludes every suite that supplies its own agent loop, and it additionally requires the suite to discriminate at local-model scale; dynamic GUI-device environments such as AndroidWorld [ 60 ] add device emulation to that list and were not candidates for the same reason. We examined five external candidates against these two filters and excluded each for cause: AppWorld [ 61 ] (all-zero at every local model tier we ran), ToolSandbox [ 62 ] and AgentBoard (the benchmark provides the agent loop; only the model varies), function-calling emission suites (model-side emission with no environment and no multi-step loop; e.g. JSON-schema emission benchmarks [ 50 ] ), CRMArena [ 63 ] (we built a local backend against the official data snapshot and probed it: gemma4:e2b 0/5, qwen3.5:4b 0/5, and the 35B tier at 40+ minutes per task with the first completed task scored 0 — no discrimination at usable throughput), and GAIA (no discrimination for local models in our runs). We report this filter explicitly so that the single-family external evidence can be weighed for what it is; the cross-benchmark agreement between LRAB and τ 2 \tau^{2} on the shared harnesses is the strongest external check available under the constraint.
paragraphs.zh: τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 是我们唯一采用的三臂外部对比基准（第四个 CLI 臂 goose 因吞吐量问题被推迟），且它来自同一个家族（一个实验室、三个领域）。这并非由于搜索不足，而是反映了一种结构性限制。Harness 对比要求 harness 本身是实验变量，因此排除了所有自带智能体循环的套件；此外，该套件还必须在本地模型尺度上具备区分能力。像 AndroidWorld [60] 这样的动态 GUI 设备环境，由于需要增加设备模拟而同样被排除在外。我们根据这两个筛选条件考察了五个外部候选基准，并分别说明了排除原因：AppWorld [61]（在我们运行的所有本地模型层级上结果均为零）、ToolSandbox [62] 和 AgentBoard（该基准由智能体循环提供，仅模型不同）、函数调用输出套件（仅在模型端有输出，没有环境也没有多步循环；例如 JSON-schema 输出基准 [50]）、CRMArena [63]（我们基于官方数据快照构建了一个本地后端并进行了测试：gemma4:e2b 得分为 0/5，qwen3.5:4b 得分为 0/5，而 35B 层级每个任务耗时超过 40 分钟，且首个完成的任务得分仍为 0——在可用吞吐量下无法实现区分），以及 GAIA（在我们的运行中，本地模型均无法实现区分）。我们明确报告这一筛选过程，以便读者能够客观看待这一来自单一家族的外部证据；在共享 harness 上，LRAB 与 τ 2 \tau^{2} 之间的跨基准一致性，是在该限制条件下可获得的最强外部验证。

paragraphs.en: At least one mechanism (the anti-loop gate, M4) was developed against a task that also appears in LRAB (WF-08): its before/after evidence is that task. More broadly, Section 5.6 discloses that three of the four ablated arms carry some in-sample exposure (finish gate, anti-loop monitor, LRAB-period strengthening of verification feedback); only the flat prefill is both pre-LRAB and inert here. There is no held-out task split and no temporal separation between mechanism development and evaluation, so test-set overfitting cannot be ruled out. We mitigate by publishing every cell so the overlap is visible, and by the external τ 2 \tau^{2} results, which were produced after the mechanisms were frozen; a held-out task split remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: 针对一项同样出现在 LRAB（WF-08）中的任务，至少开发了一种机制（反循环门 M4）：其“之前/之后”证据就是该任务。 更广泛地说，第 5.6 节披露，四个被削减的分支中有三个存在一定程度的样本内暴露（完成门、反循环监控器、LRAB 周期内验证反馈的强化）；只有平坦预填充既是 LRAB 之前的，也是在此处惰性的。 没有预留的任务划分，也没有机制开发与评估之间的时间分离，因此无法排除对测试集的过拟合。 我们通过发布每个单元格来缓解这一问题，使重叠部分可见，并通过外部 τ 2 \tau^{2} 的结果进行验证——这些结果是在机制被冻结后生成的；预留任务划分仍属未来工作。

paragraphs.en: All 288 cells ran on one Windows 11 machine (an integrated GPU, 32 GB shared memory). We do not know how the ranking transfers to Linux, to discrete GPUs, or to different memory envelopes; agent-mini’s 35B collapse is specifically a Windows interaction and would presumably not reproduce on POSIX shells. Mingbird itself is Windows-first, which has two consequences: the harness matches the benchmark platform exactly, and it is untested elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 288 个单元格都在一台 Windows 11 机器上运行（集成 GPU，32 GB 共享内存）。 我们尚不清楚该排名如何迁移到 Linux、离散 GPU 或不同的内存环境；agent-mini 的 35B 崩溃现象是 Windows 交互特有的，在 POSIX 壳环境中可能不会重现。 Mingbird 本身优先适配 Windows，这带来了两个后果：测试框架与基准平台完全匹配，且它尚未在其他环境中经过测试。

paragraphs.en: The three baseline arms ran 2026-09-01..04 and were frozen at their stock versions; the Mingbird arm ran 2026-09-13..14 with the final v1.5.0 code; the goose and opencode arms were re-shot 2026-09-18..20 under the unified protocol. Execution order was blocked, not randomized, so machine state, driver stack, and background load could in principle have drifted between campaigns. Model weights are pinned by manifest digest, which controls the model but not the runtime stack. Two facts partially compensate: the goose/opencode re-shots cross the original campaign boundary and reproduce the direction of the baseline campaign’s results, and every cell is published, making anomalies auditable. A fully interleaved replication (round-robin task order across all four arms) remains the strongest check and is future work.
paragraphs.zh: 三个基线分支在 2026-09-01..04 期间运行，并锁定在其原始版本上；Mingbird 分支在 2026-09-13..14 期间使用最终 v1.5.0 代码运行；goose 和 opencode 分支则在 2026-09-18..20 期间按照统一协议重新执行。 执行顺序是固定的，而非随机化的，因此机器状态、驱动堆栈和背景负载原则上可能在不同实验阶段之间发生变化。 模型权重通过清单摘要进行锁定，该摘要控制模型本身，但不控制运行时堆栈。 有两个事实部分抵消了这一问题：goose/opencode 的重新执行跨越了原始实验的边界，并再现了基线实验结果的趋势；此外，每个单元格都已发布，使得异常现象可以被追溯验证。 完全交错的重现测试（即四个分支之间采用轮询任务顺序）仍然是最有力的验证方法，但这属于未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: Four models, one per size point, all open-weight and served by one backend. Two further small-tier candidates were pulled and piloted for a second-family check and rejected before entering the matrix, on a criterion set in advance: a candidate must form schema-valid tool calls. minicpm5-2b and llama3.2:3b both fail that criterion in the same way — they emit argument keys the tools do not define (e.g. {"fn": …} where path is required), repeat the malformed call after the harness’s corrective message and worked example, and end with no artifacts (the first made 175 rejected calls across 449 turns; the second scored 0.00, 0.06, 0.31 and 0.00 on its first four tasks, all without a single schema-valid write). Their transcripts are archived with the data release. This is a model-side floor that none of the harness compensations we document repairs, and it is reported as such rather than as a harness result. Our “2B” label in Table 5 follows the Ollama tag naming: gemma4:e2b is a 5B-total / 2.3B-active-per-token (MatFormer) model, as stated in Table 4 . The second small-tier family of Section 5 ( qwen3.5:2b ) is a dense 2.3B model run through the same 18-task protocol, so the two low-tier results together cover a MatFormer and a dense model at that parameter point. The matrix includes no proprietary model; the frontier probe of Section 5.5 covers one hosted model, but with a single trial per arm and a cloud endpoint that is not a frozen snapshot, so harness effects at that scale remain indicative rather than established.

paragraphs.en: Scoring is deterministic and artifact-based, but the artifacts-and-checks rubrics were authored by us. Determinism removes run-to-run judgment variance, not design-time rubric bias. Partial credit weights (e.g. a cell scoring 1 / 7 1/7 or 4 / 7 4/7 ) reflect our judgment of task structure.
paragraphs.zh: 评分是确定性的且基于成果，但这些成果与检查标准是由我们制定的。 确定性消除了不同运行之间的判断差异，但并未消除设计阶段的标准偏差。 部分得分权重（例如，一个单元格得分为 1 / 7 或 4 / 7）反映了我们对任务结构的判断。

paragraphs.en: Every cell is a single run (one retry, latest attempt wins), with temperature pinned to 0 for every arm. Greedy decoding removes sampling randomness at the source, but it does not remove execution-level variance: the same-night full-mechanism re-run of Section 5.6 (identical code, model, budgets, and scoring) moved long-horizon cells by 0.5 0.5 – 0.7 0.7 and workflow cells by up to 0.43 0.43 against the matrix batch, and across three repeated same-configuration trials the arm’s total mean ranged over 0.069 0.069 with per-task long-horizon swings reaching 0.75 0.75 . Long-horizon magnitudes in Table 5 — including Mingbird’s LH-segment lead — are therefore batch-fragile and should be read as one draw per cell; the all-task and workflow-segment margins are the stable quantities. The task-level paired tests and bootstrap intervals of Section 5 are the inference this design supports, the ablation results stay directional (their intervals reflect task variance, not sampling), and the smaller segment margins (e.g. 12B: 0.906 vs. 0.772) deserve replication.
paragraphs.zh: 每个单元格都对应一次独立运行（仅一次重试，最新尝试的结果胜出），且所有分支的温度均固定为 0。 贪心解码从源头上消除了采样随机性，但并未消除执行层面的变异性：对第 5.6 节中相同夜晚的全机制重跑（代码、模型、预算和评分完全一致），长周期单元格的变动幅度为 0.5–0.7，工作流单元格的变动幅度最高可达 0.43；在三次重复的相同配置试验中，该分支的总均值波动范围达 0.069，单个任务的长周期波动甚至达到 0.75。 因此，表 5 中的长周期量级（包括 Mingbird 在 LH 阶段的领先优势）对批次数据较为敏感，应将其视为每个单元格的单次抽样结果；而所有任务及工作流阶段的差异才是稳定的指标。 第 5 节中任务层面的配对检验和自助法置信区间正是该设计所支持的有效推断；消融分析的结果方向性保持不变（其置信区间反映的是任务本身的变异性，而非采样影响），而较小的阶段差异（例如 12B：0.906 对比 0.772）值得进一步重复验证。

paragraphs.en: The τ 2 \tau^{2} comparison uses a cloud simulator ( qwen3.8-flash ) instead of the official gpt-4o user, so absolute scores are not comparable to the leaderboard; only the between-arm difference is controlled. The judge ( qwen3.8-max ) is likewise a cloud model. Both are accessed by alias through one endpoint, and a cloud alias is not a frozen snapshot; all arms were sampled in the same September 2026 window, but an independent replication today could meet a drifted simulator. Simulator behavior could also interact with harness style (e.g. tolerance for terse agent replies).
paragraphs.zh: τ 2 \tau^{2} 比较使用的是云模拟器（qwen3.8-flash），而非官方的 gpt-4o 用户，因此绝对分数无法与排行榜进行比较；仅对组间差异进行了控制。 评判模型（qwen3.8-max）同样是一个云模型。 两者均通过一个端点以别名方式访问，而云别名并非静态快照；所有组别均在 2026 年 9 月的同一时间段内采样，但今天进行的独立重复实验可能会遇到已发生漂移的模拟器。 模拟器的行为也可能与测试框架的风格产生交互（例如，对智能体简短回复的容忍度）。

paragraphs.en: Section 5.6 removes mechanisms one at a time, but only on a single 2B model over 18 tasks per arm, against a same-code control baseline, and its task-level confidence intervals all cross zero. It does not cover 4B and larger models or the multi-model matrix, and with one mechanism disabled at a time it says nothing about interactions between mechanisms. Marginal contributions at other model scales remain unmeasured.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5.6 节逐一移除机制，但仅针对单个 2B 模型在每臂 18 项任务上的表现，并与使用相同代码的对照基线进行比较，且其任务层面的置信区间均跨越零值。 该研究未涵盖 4B 及更大规模的模型或多模型矩阵，并且由于每次仅禁用一种机制，因此无法说明机制之间的相互作用。 其他模型规模下的边际贡献仍未得到测量。

paragraphs.en: The five-ring evaluation (Section 3.2.11 ) is one run per case over 54 probes and two models, on a probe set we wrote ourselves: it establishes that the rings fire on realistic requests and characterizes what leaks through, but the per-ring rates carry single-run noise, the probe set has no external red-team provenance, and both confirmed leaks are bash-side rule gaps documented as findings rather than silently patched in the evaluated tree. The false-completion-claim phenomenon it exposes is a model-level integrity problem that no host-side gate in the evaluated version closes; we report its count and the per-case evidence notes rather than claim a fix.
paragraphs.zh: 五环评估（第 3.2.11 节）针对每个案例，在 54 个探针和两种模型上各运行一次，使用的探针集由我们自行编写：该评估证实了这些“环”会对真实请求作出响应，并描述了可能泄露的内容；但每个环的速率存在单次运行的噪声，探针集没有来自外部红队的验证来源，且两种已确认的泄露均为客户端规则漏洞，这些漏洞作为发现结果被记录，而非在受评估的树结构中静默修复。 该评估揭示的虚假完成声明现象是一个模型层面上的完整性问题，而受评估版本中没有任何主机侧的防护机制能够解决此问题；我们报告了该现象的出现次数以及每个案例的相关证据说明，而非声称已找到解决方案。

paragraphs.en: For small models, the harness is not peripheral glue but a substantial part of the capability surface. The 2B segment shows this most clearly: same model, same budgets, and one harness completes 0.821 of its cells while others complete 0.017–0.271. The failure forms behind that gap (prefill overflow, unbounded demonstration loops, silent abandonment, malformed calls discarded by strict parsers) are deterministic engineering problems, and none of them requires model retraining. The frontier probe sharpens the attribution from the other direction (Section 5.5 ): with the model pinned near its ceiling, harness choice alone spans 0.478–0.997 on the same tasks, so a weak scaffold strands capability that a stronger one recovers. The ablation puts directional numbers on this attribution at 2B: the largest single loss comes from removing the finish gate (Section 5.6 ). We expect several mechanisms (flat prefill with a hard budget, finish gates, loop signatures) to transfer to larger models with weaker budgets, though our data cover only up to the 35B tier of Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于小型模型而言，harness 并非外围的粘合剂，而是能力表现的重要组成部分。 2B 模型段最清晰地体现了这一点：模型相同、预算相同，但一个 harness 能完成其单元数的 0.821，而其他 harness 仅能完成 0.017–0.271。 这一差距背后出现的故障形式（prefill 溢出、无界演示循环、静默放弃、被严格解析器丢弃的格式错误调用）都是确定性的工程问题，且无一需要重新训练模型。 前沿探针从另一个方向强化了这种归因（第 5.5 节）：当模型性能接近其上限时，仅通过选择不同的 harness，在同一任务上的表现跨度可达 0.478–0.997；因此，较弱的架构会浪费本可由更强架构恢复的能力。 在 2B 模型上，消融分析为这种归因提供了具体数值：最大的单一损失来自移除 finish gate（第 5.6 节）。 我们预计，多种机制（带有硬性预算限制的 flat prefill、finish gate、循环签名）将能迁移到预算更弱的大型模型中，尽管我们的数据仅覆盖表 4 中至多 35B 的层级。

paragraphs.en: Mingbird is Windows-first; porting the harness (notably M7’s encoding layer and M8’s path normalization) to macOS and Linux is planned. The agent-mini result shows platform fit can dominate model capability in this size class, which elevates cross-platform measurement beyond routine porting work.
paragraphs.zh: Mingbird 优先适配 Windows；计划将测试框架（尤其是 M7 的编码层和 M8 的路径标准化模块）移植到 macOS 和 Linux。 agent-mini 的结果表明，在这一尺寸级别中，平台适配性可能比模型能力更具决定性，这使得跨平台评估超越了常规的移植工作。

paragraphs.en: The natural missing baseline in LRAB is human performance: participants completing the same 18 tasks under identical budgets. A careful human baseline (a small number of participants, task order randomized, artifacts scored by the same deterministic scorer where applicable) would calibrate what 0.886 means; we consider this the most valuable single addition to the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: LRAB 中自然缺失的基准是人类的性能：参与者在完全相同的预算下完成相同的 18 项任务。 一个严谨的人类基准（少量参与者、任务顺序随机化，在适用情况下由同一确定性评分器对人工产物进行评分）将校准 0.886 这一数值的具体含义；我们认为这是对该基准最有价值的单一补充。

paragraphs.en: We presented Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama that treats small-model failure forms as first-class engineering targets. The evaluation is a fully published controlled experiment: 288 cells, four harnesses, four open models (2B–35B), one machine, and deterministic artifact-based scoring. Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631, 0.479, and 0.405 for three stock baselines, is the only harness without a small-model cliff, and leads the long-horizon segment at 0.827 (single draw per cell). An external replication on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench in all three domains (0.856 vs. 0.791 and 0.737 over 278 tasks, same local 4B model, matched user simulator, with the fourth CLI arm deferred for throughput on this benchmark) supports the direction on a third-party benchmark, and a frontier-model probe — one hosted model, four harnesses, the same 18 tasks — spans 0.997 to 0.478, showing that a defective scaffold buries more than half of a frontier model while well-formed scaffolds stay within 0.072–0.12 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation attributes the largest single share of the margin to the finish gate, and the thinking configuration itself emerges as a harness-level lever with task-dependent costs. LRAB is self-built and carries its authors’ bias; we publish every cell so that the results can be independently recomputed or refuted. Our results suggest that a substantial share of what is attributed to model incapacity in this setting is in fact scaffold defect, and such defects are addressable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 Mingbird，这是一款适用于 Windows 和 Ollama 的本地优先智能体框架，它将小模型失败模式视为一级工程目标。 该评估是一项完全公开的控制实验：包含 288 个单元格、四种框架、四种开源模型（2B–35B）、一台机器以及基于确定性人工制品的评分机制。 Mingbird 的整体得分为 0.886，而三种基准模型的得分分别为 0.631、0.479 和 0.405；它是唯一没有出现小模型性能断崖式下降的框架，并且在长时程阶段以 0.827 的得分领先（每个单元格仅抽取一次）。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 所有三个领域进行的外部复现实验支持了这一趋势：在第三方基准测试中，278 项任务的整体得分为 0.856，对比另外两种框架分别为 0.791 和 0.737（使用相同的本地 4B 模型、匹配的用户模拟器，而第四个 CLI 分支因该基准测试的吞吐量限制被暂缓）；此外，一项前沿模型探测实验——包含一个托管模型、四种框架以及相同的 18 项任务——得分范围从 0.997 到 0.478，表明有缺陷的架构会掩盖超过一半的前沿模型性能，而设计良好的架构之间的差异则控制在 0.072–0.12 以内。 通过“移除单个机制”的消融分析发现，性能差距中最大的单一贡献来自结束门控机制；而思考配置本身也被证明是一种框架层面的调节因素，其成本因任务而异。 LRAB 是自行构建的，并带有作者自身的偏见；我们公开了所有实验单元格的数据，以便他人能够独立重新计算或验证这些结果。 我们的研究结果表明，在此设定中，通常归因于模型能力不足的部分实际上源于架构缺陷，而这些缺陷是可以被解决的。

paragraphs.en: The ablation shows the population-level version of this exchange: removing the gate costs a nominal 0.098 0.098 overall, the largest single-mechanism delta in the directional ablation (Section 5.6 ).

paragraphs.en: The signature-level guard was developed against this task, where the stock loop degenerated into 156 identical tool calls with zero artifacts in the target directory. After the fix — same code, same task, same model, with the static prefill byte-identical (asserted in CI) — the same cell runs 15 tool calls and delivers 3 artifacts. The guard’s interception message tells the model why the repeat cannot succeed and what to do instead (“read the actual state first, or change strategy”), converting a silent spin into a redirect. The τ 2 \tau^{2} adapter carries the same idea (same-signature repeat ≥ \geq 4 triggers a corrective nudge).
paragraphs.zh: 这种签名级防护正是针对该任务开发的：在此任务中，原有的循环退化为 156 次完全相同的工具调用，而目标目录中却没有生成任何产物。 修复之后——代码相同、任务相同、模型相同，且静态预填充字节完全一致（已在 CI 中验证）——同一个单元格会执行 15 次工具调用，并产出 3 个产物。 防护机制的拦截信息向模型说明了为何重复操作无法成功，以及应如何替代执行（“先读取实际状态，或改变策略”），从而将一次静默的循环转变为一次方向调整。 τ 2 \tau^{2} 适配器也采用了相同的理念（签名相同的重复操作次数 ≥ \geq 4 时会触发一次纠正性提示）。

sents.zh: τ 2 \tau^{2} 适配器也采用了相同的理念（签名相同的重复操作次数 ≥ \geq 4 时会触发一次纠正性提示）。

paragraphs.en: Results vs. versions. The LRAB matrix, the ablation (including the 2026-09-22 repeats), and the τ 2 \tau^{2} arm all ran on the v1.5.0 tag ( 1ee92d1 ; factory prefill 774 tokens, pinned by that tag’s unit test); the τ 2 \tau^{2} arm in particular drives a frozen v1.5.0 tree bundled with its adapter. Two components ran later, on the product repository rather than the frozen tag, and are disclosed as such: the frontier-model probe of Section 5.5 drives the product repository’s working tree as of its run date — the 2026-09-20 four-arm campaign on the post-v1.7.0 tree (the v1.8.0 commit landed 17 minutes after the probe’s first cell), and the 2026-09-22 mechanism-ablation re-run on the v1.8.2-era tree — so probe-versus-matrix comparisons (e.g. the probe/4B juxtaposition in Section 5.5 ) are cross-version for the Mingbird arm; and the static prefill cost curve of Section 3.2 was measured on the same post-v1.7.0 tree (2026-09-20). The five-ring safety evaluation of Section 3.2.11 likewise ran on the v1.8.2-era tree rather than the v1.5.0 tag: the v1.5.0 tag predates two of the five rings. Ring history by first release, verified by matching every ring’s refusal markers against the repository’s release history: irreversible-command refusal and the workspace path boundary entered at v1.1.0, the sub-agent sandbox at v1.3.0, and risk-graded system mutation and reversibility at v1.6.0 — no tag before v1.6.0 carries the full five-ring model, so the evaluation ran on the working tree of its run date. The second small-tier family of Section 5 ( qwen3.5:2b ) ran on the same v1.5.0 code base as the matrix, with one protocol deviation: cells were run back-to-back without the per-cell backend restart used for the matrix campaigns, because that restart path proved unreliable on the machine on the day (a killed backend was repeatedly judged unreachable while other processes were using the same local Ollama instance). Scores are unaffected — scoring is deterministic and artifact-based, and no cell hit its budget — but the row’s wall-clock is not comparable to the matrix’s. The paper documents the harness at v1.6.0 (prefill 797 tokens = 774 + a 23-token safety-pad wording change, both pinned by unit test; 441 tests as collected by pytest, including parametrized cases; the release of the evaluation date, v1.8.2, collects 461 — 435 unit + 26 integration — with the count reconciliation maintained in the repository README).
paragraphs.zh: 结果与版本对比。 LRAB矩阵、消融实验（包括2026-09-22的重复实验）以及τ²臂均在v1.5.0标签上运行（1ee92d1；工厂预填充为774个token，由该标签的单元测试锁定）；特别是τ²臂驱动了一个与其适配器捆绑在一起的冻结v1.5.0树。 后续有两个组件在产品仓库而非冻结标签上运行，并明确说明如下：第5.5节的边界模型探针在运行日期时驱动了产品仓库的工作树——即2026-09-20在v1.7.0之后的树上进行的四臂实验（v1.8.0提交在该探针第一个单元格运行后17分钟完成），以及2026-09-22在v1.8.2时代树上进行的机制消融重跑——因此，探针与矩阵的比较（例如第5.5节中的探针/4B并置）对于Mingbird臂而言是跨版本的；而第3.2节的静态预填充成本曲线则是在同一v1.7.0之后的树上（2026-09-20）测量的。 第3.2.11节的五环安全评估同样在v1.8.2时代的树上运行，而非v1.5.0标签：v1.5.0标签早于五个环中的两个。 按首次发布版本划分的环历史，通过比对每个环的拒绝标记与仓库的发布历史得到验证：不可逆命令拒绝和工作区路径边界在v1.1.0时引入，子智能体沙盒在v1.3.0时引入，风险分级系统变异和可逆性在v1.6.0时引入——在v1.6.0之前的任何标签都不包含完整的五环模型，因此评估是在其运行日期的工作树上进行的。 第5节的第二个小型系列（qwen3.5:2b）与矩阵一样在相同的v1.5.0代码库上运行，但存在一项协议偏离：单元格被连续运行，未采用矩阵实验中每个单元格后重启后端的做法，因为在该日当天，这一重启路径被证明不可靠（当其他进程使用同一本地Ollama实例时，已终止的后端反复被判定为无法访问）。 评分不受影响——评分是确定性的且基于产物，也没有任何单元格超出预算——但该行的实际运行时间与矩阵的可比性不足。 论文记录了v1.6.0版本的测试框架（预填充797个token = 774 + 23个token的安全缓冲措辞变更，两者均通过单元测试锁定；pytest收集了441个测试用例，包括参数化案例；评估发布版本v1.8.2收集了461个——435个单元测试 + 26个集成测试——数量核对信息已保留在仓库的README中）。

sents.en: The τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench release used is frozen with the repository’s data release of record; the native arm is the upstream default LLM-agent implementation shipped with the τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench release used, unmodified.

paragraphs.en: Hardware: integrated GPU, 32 GB shared memory, Windows 11. Budgets: 90 minutes per workflow cell, 180 minutes per long-horizon cell; one retry, latest attempt wins; timeouts score 0.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件：集成 GPU、32 GB 共享内存、Windows 11。 预算：每个工作流单元 90 分钟，每个长期规划单元 180 分钟；允许一次重试，最新尝试的结果有效；超时则得分为 0。
